raw.description:
Position Summary:

Financial Services Representatives support learners at important moments in their education by helping them address payment concerns and stay on track with their programs. In this role, you’ll connect with learners by phone, listen to understand what is affecting their ability to pay, explain account status and available options, and help them take a clear next step. You’ll also help learners who call to make a payment. This position is a good fit for someone who enjoys helping others, can speak confidently about payments, and stays calm and focused in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment. Most of your day is spent handling calls rather than email, chat, or ticket queues. A typical day may include about 125 inbound and outbound call activities, including unanswered calls and voicemails; inbound volume may average around 70 calls. Call volume varies

Compensation:

$17 per hour, plus performance incentives. Incentive amounts vary based on the program and results and are not guaranteed.

Location and Schedule:

US-based, 100% remote role. Monday-Friday from 11:30 AM-8:00 PM Eastern time.

Training Period:

The first month focuses on inbound calls. Dialer training is introduced in the second month so you can build confidence before adding outbound calls. Performance measures are introduced gradually during the first four months as you learn the role.

Ongoing Schedule:

Inbound calls are prioritized, with outbound auto-dialer calls handled as availability allows Dialer activity can include unanswered calls and hang-ups. You’ll need to be ready to respond when a learner answers and keep a steady, professional approach throughout the day. Voluntary overtime may be available during busier periods.

Essential Job Functions:

Support learners through inbound calls and outbound auto-dialer campaigns, prioritizing inbound calls. Ask thoughtful questions to understand each learner’s situation and discuss payment options when appropriate. Explain account status and potential consequences of falling further behind, including late fees, loss of study access, or referral to a collection agency. Discuss available options within department guidelines which may include changing the payment due date, an eligible deferment, or a late-fee waiver. Process payments, document account interactions accurately, and select the appropriate call disposition. Follow privacy, call-recording disclosure, do-not-call, and other department procedures. Meet service, quality, schedule-adherence, and performance expectations, and contribute to team goals. Work with team leads and peers to resolve questions and support a collaborative remote team.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

High school diploma or GED required. Collections experience preferred; call center or customer service experience is also valuable. Direct collections experience is not required. Strong communication, active listening, probing, and problem-solving skills. Professional phone presence and the ability to stay calm and empathetic during challenging conversations. Comfort handling a high volume of calls, asking for payment, and working toward clear performance goals. Strong computer skills, including the ability to navigate multiple systems and Microsoft Outlook. Dependable, punctual, open to coaching, and willing to learn as part of a team.

Working Conditions & Hiring Process:

Role Assessment: Candidates will be required to complete a role-specific assessment as the first step in the hiring process. Assessment results will be used to evaluate alignment with the position and determine next steps in the process. U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role. Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, etc. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed. On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply. Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement. Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law. Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

Travel Expectations: This is a remote position, though occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, and similar activities. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed.

Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of the onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

About Us:

At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable them to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future. Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building teams that are diverse – in identities, lived experiences, and ideas to create a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because it is the foundation that enables us to achieve what we set out to do as an organization – from maximizing the number of learners who can reach their goals while giving them the kinds of experiences we want them to have, to becoming the type of company we want to work in.

What We Offer:

We offer a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending, generous paid time off, sponsored volunteer opportunities, a 401K with a company match, plus free access to all of our online programs.

raw.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

We are seeking an Implementation Consultant (Functional/Project Lead) to lead the functional and project management work required to successfully deploy our SaaS platform for enterprise utility customers. This role is critical to ensuring structured, well-coordinated, and repeatable implementations for customers operating critical infrastructure.


The Implementation Consultant serves as the functional owner of implementation workstreams, partnering closely with a dedicated Tech/Solution Consultant, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to deliver high-quality customer deployments. This role focuses on business process alignment, project coordination, and customer-facing enablement required to bring customers live — including requirements gathering, timeline management, stakeholder coordination, and functional configuration decisions (hazard/task libraries, templates, workflows, roles and permissions).


This is a high-impact opportunity within a growing enterprise SaaS organization supporting the Utilities & Energy sector, where operational alignment, clear communication, and reliable project delivery are essential.


Location: United States (Remote) with up to 50% travel


Duties and Responsibilities:

Implementation & Project Leadership

  • Lead the functional implementation workstream for enterprise customer deployments from kickoff through go-live, demonstrating accountability for delivery quality and outcomes
  • Own the project timeline, task tracking, and coordination across internal teams and customer stakeholders
  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer business processes, operational workflows, and organizational requirements
  • Translate business requirements into functional configuration plans — hazard/task libraries, templates, workflows, roles and permissions
  • Partner closely with the Tech/Solution Consultant to align functional decisions with technical implementation (integrations, SSO, data migration, environment setup)
  • Lead regular customer checkpoints, status updates, and cross-functional alignment meetings
  • Track and document implementation activities to support transparency, knowledge sharing, and repeatability

Business Process & Configuration Design

  • Lead business process design workshops with customer stakeholders (Safety Managers, Ops Leads, Supervisors)
  • Own configuration decisions related to forms, templates, hazard/control libraries, and workflow design
  • Validate that configured workflows reflect real-world field operations and customer requirements
  • Partner with SMEs to ensure the solution supports day-to-day operational needs

Training, Adoption & Change Support

  • Support training planning and delivery, partnering with the Comms/Change Lead on rollout strategy
  • Identify Field Champions and support their enablement ahead of Field Pilot
  • Gather and incorporate field feedback during Pilot and early go-live into configuration adjustments
  • Communicate new product releases and relevant feature updates to customers, helping them understand and adopt new capabilities as they become available

Testing, Validation & Go-Live Readiness

  • Coordinate UAT planning and execution from a functional/business-process perspective
  • Identify and communicate functional risks, dependencies, or blockers impacting launch readiness
  • Support go-live cutover planning and ensure clean handoff to Customer Success and Support

Scalable Implementation Practices

  • Identify recurring functional/configuration challenges and convert them into reusable templates and standard approaches
  • Collaborate with Product to shape configuration tooling and platform enhancements based on field learnings
  • Create documentation or toolsets that reduces manual effort and improves implementation velocity across future deployments

Required Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in implementation consulting, project management, business analysis, or customer-facing SaaS deployment roles
  • Proven experience leading project or functional workstreams for enterprise software implementations
  • Ability to translate customer business requirements into scalable, well-documented configuration plans
  • Strong project management skills — timeline management, stakeholder coordination, risk/dependency tracking
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with a technical counterpart (Tech/Solution Consultant), customer stakeholders, and internal cross-functional teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead workshops and build stakeholder confidence and trust

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience implementing software for utility, energy, industrial, or regulated enterprise customers
  • Experience deploying software to field/frontline environments (mobile applications, operational or field-based platforms) is a plus
  • Familiarity with change management or training rollout for operational teams
  • Background in business process design, workflow configuration, or configuration-heavy SaaS platforms
  • Experience with reporting or dashboards using SQL and visualization tools

Physical Demands: No specific physical demands associated with this position.

Benefits Info:

This position also includes a competitive benefit package including; financial, social, health and wellbeing programs, paid vacation, 401k matching, employee stock purchase program, hybrid work schedule, and more!

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email .

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world:

raw.description:
Duties & responsibilities

  • Design and implement back-end services using .NET / ASP.NET Core (Web API) with clean, testable code.
  • Build responsive, maintainable Angular front-ends (routing, state, RxJS, forms, performance).
  • Model data and write efficient SQL Server queries, views, stored procedures, and indexes.
  • Apply secure-by-default practices: authentication/authorization, input validation, OWASP, and secrets.
  • Design modular architectures (DDD-inspired layering, CQRS where relevant); document decisions (ADR).
  • Integrate with internal/external systems via REST/JSON (and SOAP when required).
  • Own code reviews, CI/CD quality gates, and observability (logging, tracing, dashboards, alerts).
  • Collaborate with PMs, designers, QA, and DevOps; break down epics into deliverable increments.
  • Troubleshoot production issues (query tuning, memory/CPU profiling, dependency bottlenecks).
  • Mentor engineers, contribute to shared libraries, templates, and engineering playbooks.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years professional software development, including 3+ years with ASP.NET Core.
  • Proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, dependency injection, middleware, and configuration.
  • Strong Angular (v13+) experience: components, modules, RxJS, state management, lazy loading.
  • Solid SQL Server skills: schema design, query tuning, indexing strategies, transactions.
  • Practical experience with Git, code reviews, branching, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps).
  • Strong understanding of REST, HTTP, caching, pagination, and API versioning.
  • Testing mindset: unit/integration tests (xUnit/NUnit), front-end tests (Jasmine/Karma/Jest).
  • Ability to decompose problems, estimate, and deliver iteratively.

Nice to have (Big Plus)

  • ABP Framework (modular monolith, permission/feature management, multi-tenancy, auditing, background jobs, localization).
  • Message brokers (RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus), Redis for caching, Hangfire/Quartz for jobs.
  • Security: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, IdentityServer/Entra ID, role/claim-based authorization.
  • Cloud (Azure preferred): App Service, Key Vault, Storage, SQL Managed Instance, App Insights.
  • Front-end tooling: Nx, ESLint, Prettier; performance profiling and Core Web Vitals awareness.
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, log aggregation (ELK/Seq).
  • Experience in regulated or enterprise environments (auditing, compliance, SDLC controls).

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior Manufacturing Engineer will manage and coordinate delivery projects within the Supplier Performance & Execution Sourcing Section. You will organize and coordinate multi-functional teams to execute on product delivery improvements, support the Sourcing team and suppliers to resolve technical issues, while providing expertise to the team on manufacturing processes.

Job Description

Company Overview
Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!

Site Overview
Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing

Role Overview

  • Manufacturing Engineering focal for assigned supplier base. Expected to own the technical performance of multiple suppliers so supplier travel will be frequent (25-50%).
  • Proactively identifies delivery barriers and resolves with fulfilment, commercial and quality team members. Is recognized as a critical team member by supplier or commodity
  • Acts as a Project Manager for large complex suppliers along with others
  • Has manufacturing expertise across multiple related part families and processes, along with deep domain expertise.
  • Guides and influences suppliers’ performance based on manufacturing expertise.
  • Actively drives cost reduction efforts within assigned supply base and is proactively engaged in addressing cost issues.
  • Active in supplier selection based on value. Partners with commercial owners to ensure supplier selection provides desired value
  • Supports source changes as needed and develops lower performing suppliers

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Manufacturing)
  • At least 10 - 15 years of experience in Manufacturing, Engineering or Production Management

Desired Characteristics:

  • Expertise in programming or mechanically supporting traditional (milling, turning, broach, weld) and/or non-traditional (EDM, 3D printing) machining methods.
  • Souring, Shop Operations, or Production Control expertise
  • Manufacturing Experience in Aerospace or Automotive a plus
  • Humble: respectful, inclusive, good listener, learns from past
  • Transparent: Candid in feedback, shares to solve problems, helps grow others
  • Focused: Safety first, prioritizes work, measures success by the customer, continuously improves
  • Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative​
  • Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. Where others stop, we accelerate.

This Job Description is intended to provide a high-level guide to the role. However, it is not intended to amend or otherwise restrict/expand the duties required from each individual employee as set out in their respective employment contract and/or as otherwise agreed between an employee and their manager.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

- This is a remote position

raw.description:
At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.

Role Overview:

Could you be our next Customer Retention Representative? Globe Life is looking for a Customer Retention Representative to join the team!


In this role, you will be responsible for conserving business on behalf of the Company. You’ll be a vital part of a dedicated, professional team. Representatives play a key role in ensuring that customers who call to cancel are helped understand the importance of keeping their coverage and receive policy maintenance.


***This is a remote/work-from-home position with AM and PM shifts available

What You Will Do (All Shifts)

  • Answer questions regarding coverage, premium, and other policy information.
  • Make outbound calls to existing policyholders to retain, resell, and recover lapsed or delinquent policies.
  • Recommend appropriate coverage adjustments based on individual policyholder needs.
  • Record and maintain accurate policyholder information for reporting and transactional purposes.
  • Communicate clearly and empathetically, adapting your style to each customer's needs.
  • Follow up with customers to confirm understanding and satisfaction with proposed solutions.
  • Maintain discretion and tact; extensive telephone contact required.
  • Work independently and exercise sound judgment.
  • Stay current on life insurance products, policy features, and company procedures.
  • Meet or exceed contact center KPIs include call volume, retention rate, first call resolution, adherence, call quality, and attendance expectations.
  • Bilingual (Spanish) hourly pay differential.

AM Shift – Additional Responsibilities

  • Handle inbound calls from policyholders requesting cancellations and explore retention options.
  • Proactively contact customers with lapsed policies to discuss payment solutions.

PM Shift – Additional Responsibilities

  • Make outbound calls to collect delinquent premium payments.
  • Compose business letters and communicate effectively through written and verbal communication.

What You Can Bring:

  • High school diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Basic Microsoft Office Skills, including Word, Excel, and Outlook, are required.
  • A minimum typing speed of 30 wpm is required.
  • Experience in a call center environment is preferred.
  • Some insurance and/or sales experience is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to solve complex policyholder issues with a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and work well under pressure.
  • Knowledge of life and/or health insurance terminology preferred.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

  • Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.

  • Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

How Globe Life Will Support You:

Looking to continue your career in an environment that values your contribution and invests in your growth? We've curated a benefits package that helps to ensure that you don’t just work, but thrive at Globe Life:

  • Competitive compensation designed to reflect your expertise and contribution.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans because your well-being is fundamental to your performance.

  • Robust life insurance benefits and retirement plans, including company-matched 401k and pension plan.

  • Paid holidays and time off to support a healthy work-life balance.

  • Parental leave to help our employees welcome their new additions.

  • Subsidized all-in-one subscriptions to support your fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep goals.

  • Company-paid counseling for assistance with mental health, stress management, and work-life balance.

  • Continued education reimbursement eligibility and company-paid FLMI and ICA courses to grow your career.

  • Discounted Texas Rangers tickets for a proud visit to Globe Life Field.

Opportunity awaits! Invest in your professional legacy, realize your path, and see the direct impact you can make in a workplace that celebrates and harnesses your unique talents and perspectives to their fullest potential. At Globe Life, your voice matters.

raw.description:
About ITC

Join ITC, a trailblazing force with offices in Shanghai, Singapore, and Saigon. We are a hub of innovation for Fortune 500 companies and industry leaders, guiding them through the complexities of the Chinese and APAC markets.

At ITC, you'll play a pivotal role in transforming their business landscapes using cutting-edge MarTech, e-Commerce, and Omnichannel solutions. As part of our team, you'll not only witness but also contribute to significant ROI achievements and market successes. We're not just navigating the future of digital commerce; we're creating it.

Our expertise includes:

  • Digital Transformation & Change Management (including Digital Transformation Talent Augmentation)
  • CRM, CDP, Data, Marketing Automation & Clienteling
  • Talent Augmentation Solutions
  • Tailor-made Digital & Commerce Experiences: WeChat Mini Programs, Websites, Apps
  • System Integration, APIs & Infrastructure Management.

Job summary

As a Program Manager for a leading International Luxury Brand, your primary responsibility is to manage multiple workstreams for regional IT Projects, including Clienteling, Salesforce, and system integrations, spearheading implementation of digital transformation for local solutions. This role requires exceptional communication skills and the ability to coordinate between global and local teams and vendors, effectively handling complex situations.

Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery:

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of key projects related to Clienteling, Salesforce CRM, and system integrations.
  • Ensure alignment with global team and local team strategies, managing projects from conception to completion, including resource allocation, timeline management, and budget control.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, KPIs, ensuring milestones and deliverables are met on time and within scope.
  • Organize meetings, workshops, and initiatives related to the project

Team & Vendor Management:

  • Lead and manage cross-functional teams, both locally and globally, to ensure seamless collaboration and communication.
  • Coordinate with external vendors and partners, negotiate contracts, and ensure deliverables meet the companys high standards.
  • Provide guidance and support to project teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.

Stakeholder Communication:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communication, ensuring all internal and external stakeholders are regularly updated on progress, risks, and issues.
  • Facilitate meetings, presentations, and status reports to senior management, providing clear and concise updates on project status and outcomes.
  • Manage change requests and ensure alignment with business goals and priorities.

Risk Management:

  • Proactively identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, regulations, and quality standards throughout all project phases.

Digital Roadmap Compliance & Development:

  • Work on developing short-term and long-term Digital Transformation roadmap with the Regional IT leaders, while also performing internal and external risk management throughout the project's timeline.
  • Comply with all procedures of company's IT project and releasement management policy by working closely with the Global IT PMO.

Process Improvement & Governance:

  • Provide mentorship to project team members through both written and verbal feedback.
  • Establish and enforce project management standards, methodologies, and best practices across all projects.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, implementing changes to enhance project delivery efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Handle other ad hoc tasks as assigned.

Requirements

Must have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Possess a PMP (PMI) certification or any other relevant certification.
  • Proven track record with 6-8 years of experience in IT Project Management, managing large-scale, complex projects across multiple regions, coordinating with global teams and vendors.
  • High level stakeholders' management skills, including the ability to build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders from local to global.
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English, with exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excels at conveying complex information clearly and effectively across all levels.
  • Skilled at managing and resolving complex situations in dynamic environments.
  • Strong presentation skill, preferably in Technical Solutions.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to work in a multi-cultural, global IT organization.

Nice to have:

  • Proven experience in Business Analysis and Business Process Modeling.
  • Familiar with the digital transformation landscape and ecosystem in China (WeChat/Wecom)
  • Experienced with Cloud Platforms (e.g. Ali Cloud, Azure)
  • Experienced with major platform migration or transformation projects.
  • Willingness to work in a fast-paced environment, to adapt quickly to changing priorities and learn new technologies and build great relationships with all stakeholders

Contract duration is 5 months, with high potential to convert to FTE based on project needs and performance.

**This position is contingent upon contract award.**


Leidos is seeking an experienced Deputy Program Manager (DPM) for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (ATLAS) program. ATLAS supports secure, governed enterprise data access, cloud platform services, customer onboarding, advanced analytics, and AI/ML enablement across VA.


Remote work within the continental United States is permitted subject to VA security and system-access approval. Washington, DC metropolitan-area candidates are preferred. Must support Eastern Time collaboration and program operating requirements; occasional travel and after-hours/weekend escalation support may be necessary.


Reporting to the Program Manager, the DPM leads day-to-day delivery for an assigned program vertical: Summit Users (customer engagement, intake, onboarding, adoption, training, and support) or Product, Data, and Continuous Improvement (architecture, security, platform enhancement, data services, governance, and AI/ML enablement). The DPM integrates Leidos and subcontractor resources, manages performance and dependencies, and ensures operational continuity while balancing schedule, service quality, and firm-fixed-price financial constraints.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead daily execution across assigned PWS workstreams; coordinate delivery teams, shared technical specialists, and subcontractor partners against one integrated backlog and schedule.
  • Serve as the designated backup to the Program Manager, assuming program-level coordination, customer engagement, operational oversight, and decision-making responsibilities during the PM's absence, within delegated authority.
  • Translate VA priorities into actionable work plans, milestones, staffing assignments, delivery forecasts, and measurable outcomes; coordinate Agile/product-centric planning and reviews.
  • Manage staffing readiness, resource utilization, recruiting needs, performance, and succession/backup coverage within assigned workstreams; coordinate VA onboarding, access dependencies, and operational readiness.
  • Monitor assigned workstream budgets, labor mix, subcontractor expenditures, and forecast performance; identify staffing or delivery decisions that could erode contract margins and recommend corrective action to the Program Manager.
  • Maintain risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action logs; oversee deliverable quality, timeliness, reporting, service levels, and corrective actions within assigned workstreams; escalate significant issues to the Program Manager and appropriate VA stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with VA stakeholders, product owners, technical leads, security personnel, and subcontractors to resolve priorities, approvals, handoffs, and operational problems.
  • Support transition-in and steady-state operations, including incumbent knowledge transfer, service continuity, and operational handover; promote process improvement, automation, and measurable productivity gains.
  • Provide management escalation support for urgent incidents when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of relevant experience, including 4+ years leading or supervising teams or complex projects;
  • Experience managing delivery of complex enterprise IT, cloud, data, analytics, or software programs with multiple technical disciplines and interdependent workstreams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage schedules, staffing, budgets, risks, deliverables, and customer expectations, including coordination of subcontractor or partner teams.
  • Experience with Agile or product-centric delivery, cross-team dependencies, and operational performance measures.
  • Ability to lead technical and customer-facing teams, resolve competing priorities, communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, and deliver under demanding timelines.
  • Working knowledge of federal IT security, personnel onboarding, and service-management concepts sufficient to coordinate specialist teams and Government dependencies.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or supporting federal government IT contracts, including contract performance, schedule and financial management, subcontractor coordination, and compliance with contractual deliverables and reporting requirements.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required VA Public Trust suitability determination.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Highly preferred: Direct experience supporting the VA Summit Data Platform, its operating environment, customer workflows, or adjacent VA enterprise data and analytics programs.
  • Experience managing VA or other federal IT contracts, especially incumbent-contractor transitions, service continuity, knowledge transfer, Government onboarding, continuity of operations, and geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience with firm-fixed-price delivery, labor forecasting, subcontractor oversight, and balancing staffing quality, speed, and affordability.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, data platforms/lakehouse operations, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, ServiceNow, or AI/ML enablement.
  • One or more of the following - PMP, PgMP, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, or comparable program/product delivery certification.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Location: India
Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

  • Requests for help during the job.

What You Will Bring As A Service Rep II

  • Ability to work during business hours and as required by business needs
  • Prior customer service experience, 2 years minimum.
  • Positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers (consumers, moving service providers) and peers at all times.
  • Ability to learn and retain product details to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in U.S. customer service.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a Senior Agent, Team Lead, or Supervisory capacity within U.S. customer service, BPO, or home services/moving-industry environment OR 8 years of experience in U.S. customer service.
  • Higher Secondary Certificate (10+2) or equivalent.
  • Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, Supply Chain/Logistics,Hospitality Management, or similar.
  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills.
  • Ability to work scheduled hours during business hours and as required by business needs.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding performance metrics in a front-line customer service role.
  • Prior experience training, mentoring, or directly supporting other customer service representatives.
  • A positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers (consumers, service providers) and peers at all times.
  • Ability to learn and retain product details to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Ability to access and act quickly on workflows so that every inquiry is addressed promptly.
  • Intentionally, accurately, and consistently communicate brand (Managed/Marketplace) policies that apply to customer/service provider issues.
  • Ability to meet metrics for your given position.
  • Strong time management skills and a committed work ethic.
  • Excellent communication, sales, and customer service.
  • You learn quickly, and are resourceful and have the ability to seek out appropriate points of contact to get all necessary information.
  • Display flexibility by supporting all groups within PMG.
  • Ability to grow and maintain beneficial B2B partnerships.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining creative thinking.
  • Proficient computer skills using Microsoft Office, Internet Explorer, and GSuite, with the ability to learn new software solutions.
  • Workspace: A quiet space to work, an internet connection of at least 30 Mbps download | 10 Mbps upload.
  • Full US time-zone overlap
  • This role requires full and ongoing overlap with Porch’s U.S. Central Time business hours (11:30 PM IST – 7:00 AM IST).
  • A Night Shift Allowance is applicable for this position in line with company policy.
  • Workspace: A quiet space to work, an internet connection of at least 30 Mbps download | 10 Mbps upload

What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: 6,00,000 INR – 8,00,000 INR annually

*Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets,job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.

You will also be eligible to receive sales incentives, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

  • Our benefits include medical insurance, accident insurance and retiral benefits.
  • Our wellness programs include 12 company-paid holidays, 2 flexible holidays, privilege/earned leave, casual/sick leave, paid maternity and paternity Leaves, and weekly wellness events.

What’s next?

Submit your application below and our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

raw.description:
📌 Opdracht

Voor een platform dat douane, scheepsagenten, terminals en logistieke partners verbindt, wordt nieuwe functionaliteit ontwikkeld ter vervanging van software die in 2027 wordt uitgefaseerd. Om de vaste deadline te halen, schakelt het team over op agentic engineering. De lead begeleidt deze eerste toepassing binnen de organisatie en zorgt ervoor dat het team blijft leveren terwijl het een nieuwe werkwijze aanleert.

  • Samen met de product owner en tech lead een baseline bepalen van de huidige delivery, met aandacht voor de Agile werkwijze, kwaliteit en resultaten.
  • De invoering van agentic engineering vormgeven en aansturen binnen het softwareteam.
  • Het team coachen tijdens de verandering en de verschillende rollen betrekken, waaronder ontwikkelaars, product owner, analist, tester en leiderschap.
  • Na elke sprint aan de stuurgroep of directie rapporteren over voortgang, kwaliteit, adoptie en de verhouding tussen kosten en waarde.
  • De resultaten van het team meetbaar maken ten opzichte van een duidelijk vertrekpunt.
  • Een onderbouwde aanbeveling formuleren over de toepassing van deze werkwijze in volgende teams.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt minstens twee trajecten begeleid waarin softwareteams tijdens een lopende delivery overstapten naar AI-ondersteunde of agentic softwareontwikkeling.
  • Je hebt minstens vijf jaar ervaring als softwarearchitect of in een vergelijkbare technische leidinggevende rol.
  • Je hebt ervaring met digitale transformatie, coaching en het begeleiden van volledige softwareteams.
  • Je hebt ervaring met Azure DevOps binnen softwaredelivery en begrijpt hoe je Agile werkafspraken in een team toepast.
  • Je kunt de impact van een verandertraject rapporteren aan een stuurgroep of directie.
  • Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en kunt je ook in het Engels uitdrukken.

📌 Pluspunten

  • Ervaring in de haven-, maritieme of logistieke sector.
  • Praktijkervaring met GitHub Copilot of vergelijkbare tools voor agentic engineering.
  • Ervaring met het opleiden van volledige teams, met betrokkenheid van alle rollen.

⚠️ Deze functie wordt aangeboden als een deeltijdse freelance rol (40%).

🌟 About us, WeAssist, the hiring team 💡

🌍 Led by a Founder Who Cares – Reef Colman built WeAssist to empower individuals and create meaningful opportunities that support families.
⚡ Fast & Purposeful Recruiting – We move quickly but prioritize long-term fit, stability, and growth over just filling roles.
🌎 Connecting Global Talent – With 100+ outsourced professionals and growing, we link top talent worldwide with thriving US businesses.
❤️ Giving Back Matters – From building schools to feeding the homeless, we believe true success means making a difference.
🤝 An Inclusive & Thriving Culture – Your skills and unique gifts matter. We create an environment where outsourced professionals don’t just work—they grow.

⚒️ Key Responsibilities of the Full Cycle Recruiter 📝

➡️ LinkedIn Sourcing

➡️ Conducting Interviews

➡️ Expert Interviewing Techniques
➡️ Elevated Candidate Experience
➡️ Recruiting Process Development
➡️ ATS Implementation/Management
➡️ Administrative Tasks
➡️ Occasional Project Management

⚒️ Key Qualifications of the Full Cycle Recruiter 📝

➡️ AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using AI for recruiting workflows (screening, ranking, summaries, outreach, interview design) and building prompt libraries.
➡️ Automation Skills: Proven ability to create no-code automations (Zapier/Make/n8n) that connect ATS/CRM, calendars, and communication tools.
➡️ Full-Cycle Recruiting Mastery – 2+ years managing requisitions end-to-end: sourcing, screening, and interviewing, along with strong Boolean search and multi-channel sourcing
➡️ LinkedIn Recruiter Proficiency – Extensive experience sourcing top-tier candidates using advanced LinkedIn Recruiter search techniques.
➡️ CBBI & Soft Skills Screening – Skilled at conducting in-depth CBBI (competency-based behavioral interviews) and assessing soft skills to ensure cultural fit.

Additional Information:
📢 Why Are We Hiring a Full Cycle Recruiter?

As a Full-Cycle Recruiter, you're more than a talent scout—you're a pioneer in expanding our top-tier recruitment divisions worldwide. Your mission? To ace screening, conduct killer interviews, and match-make dream teams for our clients. With your keen eye and innovative strategies, you'll create mutually beneficial opportunities for clients and outsourced professionals alike, fueling growth and empowerment across the globe. Ready to make waves? Let's do this! 🚀

Responsibilities of the Full Cycle Recruiter:
Your responsibilities include:

  • LinkedIn Sourcing:
    • Utilizing either LinkedIn Recruiter (Corporate) or LinkedIn Recruiter Lite to find, source, and identify talent with a good understanding of which filters to use and why
    • How to separate key elements of the role into different Boolean brackets
    • Robust understanding of how to narrow and broaden talent pools based on the requirements of the role

  • Conducting Interviews:
    • Intro Interviews (15mins)
    • Group Interviews (if necessary)
    • 1on1 Interviews (1 hour)
    • Follow and master the Interview Flow, then begin to innovate and tailor interview processes for optimal success

  • Expert Interviewing Techniques:
    • Probe into candidate experiences to discern strengths, weaknesses, and career experience. Understanding how to identify and probe into red flags, determine suitability, and evaluate candidates thoroughly
    • Must be highly skilled at identifying skillset, talent, and culture fits
    • Impeccable Discernment - Knowing who is a good fit, and who is not a good fit, based on culture, soft skills and hard skills

  • Elevated Candidate Experience:
    • Champion a professional and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment life cycle, from start to finish
    • Disqualify candidates who are not a fit, live-on-call, and give constructive feedback to aid them in future applications

  • ATS Implementation and Management:
    • Must be able to utilize ATS systems for our teams to ensure effective pairings between client and candidate, and ensure candidates are in the correct pipelines/stages
    • Pipeline Management - Finding existing candidates within our database that may be a great fit for current requisitions

  • AI Implementations/Automations:
    • Creating workflows and automations to streamline and automate parts of the Recruiting Process
    • Researching AI tools/technology that can support Recruiting Process Optimisation
    • Assisting the team in optimising a migration to GoHighLevel as an Applicant Tracking System
      • Creating and supporting in developing workflows, automations and pipeline processes to optimise the Recruiting Process
    • Offering support in building the highest quality, effective, and streamlined recruiting process to find high-level outsourced professionals
  • Administrative Tasks:
    • Ensuring that there are accurate and up-to-date notes on candidate profiles
    • Updating trackers with daily, weekly, and monthly metrics
    • End-of-day reporting

  • 🤖 AI-Driven Recruiting & Automation
    • Build and maintain AI-assisted workflows for sourcing, screening, and shortlisting (e.g., automated resume parsing, skill tagging, and candidate ranking using AI tools)
    • Use AI to draft/refine JDs, outreach copy, interview guides, and candidate summaries; A/B test prompts for higher response and conversion rates
    • Create automations across ATS/CRM, calendars, and comms tools (e.g., Zapier/Make/n8n) for interview scheduling, pipeline alerts, status updates, and follow-ups
    • Set up AI-powered dashboards and reports to monitor pipeline health, SLAs, and client-ready batch quality
    • Maintain a prompt library and SOPs for repeatable, high-quality outputs; continuously fine-tune based on client feedback and outcomes
    • Evaluate and implement new AI tools/models (e.g., ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity, sourcing extensions) while ensuring data privacy and compliance
    • Train team members on best-practice prompting and QA standards for AI-generated deliverables

🏡 Get To Know WeAssist!

Started by Reef Colman just five years ago, is not your typical staffing agency...

We are a dynamic recruiting firm focused on creating fair opportunities in the business world. We have a team of over 120 Outsourced Professionals. We help US businesses find skilled remote workers and connect these workers with good employers.

What makes us different is how much we care about our people! We give good benefits, support personal growth, and get involved in the community. We also support good causes like building schools, helping the homeless, and improving education. Come join us at WeAssist, where remote workers do their best! ✨

Company Culture and Core Values:

At WeAssist, we move fast, think big, and create lasting impact. 🚀 We’re more than just a recruiting firm—we’re a tight-knit community that values integrity, accountability, and growth, ensuring every professional and client finds the right fit, not just any fit. Here, you’ll thrive in an inclusive, high-performance culture that challenges you to be 1% better every day while making a real difference in the world. 🌍✨

  • 🧭 Integrity– Do the Right Thing, Always
    • Even when no one’s watching, we lead with honesty, character, and trust.
  • 🎯 Expectation – Set the Target Early
    • We align from the start—no guessing games. Clarity creates confidence.
  • 🔁 Reiteration – Say It Back, Get It Right

  • 🧱 Major Ownership – Being 1% Better Every Time

  • 🔍 Radical Transparency – Keep It Real
    • We speak with openness and honesty.
  • 🚀 Proactive Effort – Stay Ahead of the Game
    • We don’t wait for fires—we prevent them. Anticipate, act, exceed.
  • 🗣️ Communication – Listen First, Speak with Clarity
    • We listen to understand, not just to reply. The clearer we are, the stronger we move!
  • 🧑‍💼 We Talk About Projects, Not People – No Gossip Zone
    • We go directly to the source. Discuss issues, not individuals—unless it’s for solutions.
  • 🧠 Be Curious – Ask, Learn, Level Up
    • Curiosity drives growth. We ask smart questions and never stop learning.
  • 🧊 Emotional Regulation – Keep Cool Under Pressure
    • We stay calm, think clearly, and lead with emotional maturity—especially when it’s tough.
  • 🏅 A-Player Mentality – Results Over Excuses
    • We get things done. Whatever it takes to win with integrity, we’re in.
  • ➕ One More Mindset – Because It Matters to Someone
    • One more call. One more check-in. One more push. Every extra effort counts.

Join a team that values growth, action, and real impact—where what you do truly matters! 🎉

What’s in it for you? 😏

Joining us means not just filling a role but embarking on a personal development journey. The growth potential is substantial, with opportunities to:

About DoktorABC & Helfy

Helfy is a European leader in digital health, facilitating over 300,000 monthly treatments across the continent through our flagship platform, DoktorABC. We connect licensed physicians, partner pharmacies, and patients to provide high quality care and make healthcare faster, discreet, and reliable.

As we expand our footprint in the French market, we are looking for dedicated Independent General Practitioners to join our medical network.   • 100% Remote Opportunity: Conduct consultations entirely remotely from home or your chosen workspace, wherever you are based, provided you hold valid authorization to practice in France.

Requirements

  • Licensing & Registration: Medical Doctor (MD) fully registered with the Conseil National de l’Ordre des Médecins (CNOM), holding an active RPPS number and legal authorization to practice medicine in France.

  • Insurance: Active individual professional indemnity insurance (Responsabilité Civile Professionnelle – RCP) covering telemedicine activities for French patients.
  • Setup & Tech: Reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet and private space ensuring patient confidentiality, and a secure computer setup adhering to healthcare data security standards.
  • Communication: Professional, empathetic bedside manner well-suited for asynchronous reviews and video-based teleconsultations.

GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Risk Adjustment services, helping healthcare organizations optimize operations, improve financial performance, maintain compliance, and enhance the patient experience. Recognized as a KLAS® Top Performer, GeBBS combines innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence to deliver measurable results for clients across the healthcare industry. We are dedicated to being a trusted healthcare partner by upholding the highest standards of quality, information security, and compliance.

At GeBBS, we foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture where employees are empowered to develop their skills, advance their careers, and make a meaningful impact in transforming healthcare.

Responsibilities

The Authorization Representative will need to cover authorizations for all services (CT, MRI, echo, surgery, minor procedures, heart monitor, PFTs, sleep studies, IP, Observations, Swing Bed, ED, VA), excluding STAT requests.
Initial request and follow up required along with reporting of authorization status.

Prior Authorization and Eligibility

  • Initiate, submit, and track prior authorization requests across commercial and managed care payers.
  • Verify patient eligibility and benefits prior to authorization submission and confirm coverage, plan requirements, authorization thresholds, deductibles, copays, and other applicable benefit information.
  • Ensure authorization requests contain complete and accurate demographic, clinical, and supporting documentation.
  • Monitor pending authorization requests through payer portals and direct payer communication and proactively follow up through resolution.
  • Document authorization numbers, approved services, CPT codes, effective dates, expiration dates, session or visit limits, and other payer requirements.

Concurrent Reviews and Authorization Management

  • Manage concurrent review, continued stay, and authorization renewal requirements for ongoing services.
  • Track authorization limits and expiration dates and initiate renewals before existing authorizations are exhausted.
  • Maintain accurate authorization records and communicate pending or expiring authorizations to appropriate operational and clinical teams.
  • Help prevent gaps in authorization that could result in delayed services or lost reimbursement.

Denials and Appeals

  • Review authorization-related denials and determine whether the cause is clinical, administrative, eligibility-related, or procedural.
  • Coordinate appropriate corrective action and appeal activity within payer deadlines.
  • Prepare clear and accurate appeal documentation and coordinate with clinical and operational teams to obtain supporting information when required.
  • Track appeals through resolution and maintain complete documentation of outcomes.
  • Identify recurring denial trends and escalate systemic payer or process issues.

Payer and Revenue Cycle Coordination

  • Serve as a resource for payer authorization requirements, policies, portals, and workflows.
  • Maintain current knowledge of payer requirements and communicate material changes to appropriate teams.
  • Coordinate with billing, intake, clinical, credentialing, and contracting teams to resolve authorization-related reimbursement barriers.
  • Support single-case agreements, out-of-network authorization requests, and other payer authorization functions as needed.
  • Assist with payer audits and utilization management reviews by providing complete authorization records and supporting documentation.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and timely authorization activity within applicable EHR, practice management, and tracking systems.
  • Maintain payer authorization matrices and workflow documentation, including submission requirements, turnaround times, authorization limits, and renewal requirements.
  • Track authorization performance, including approval rates, denial rates, appeal outcomes, turnaround times, and outstanding requests.
  • Identify trends and recommend workflow improvements that strengthen revenue integrity and reduce preventable denials.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA and all applicable privacy and confidentiality requirements.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, with direct responsibility for prior authorization, eligibility and benefit verification, payer follow-up, or related revenue cycle functions.
  • Strong understanding of prior authorization requirements, payer timelines, submission processes, and authorization tracking.
  • Strong understanding of the differences between eligibility, benefits, authorization, and medical necessity requirements.
  • Experience working with commercial and managed care payers.
  • Experience using payer portals such asAvaility, NaviNet, and payer-specific platforms.
  • Working knowledge of CPT codes and their relationship to payer authorization requirements.
  • Experience managing denials and authorization appeals.
  • Experience with EHR, practice management, or other healthcare revenue cycle systems.

Requirements

  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple authorization queues and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with payer representatives and internal operational teams.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare privacy requirements.
  • CPC required. PACS preferred.
  • US based candidates eligible for employment without sponsorship.

This position is responsible for the successful execution of account and territory strategies for assigned broker dealers distributing TruStage Annuities. This includes acquisition, optimization and retention of business. Provide strategic support to wholesalers to enhance their efforts of F2F product distribution through affiliated representatives and external broker dealers. Develop and implement strategic plans for business development with investment advisors and help manage the relationship with key managers with external broker dealers.

Employ consultative selling approach to support retail sales activities including increasing sales and market share objectives within an assigned geographic region. This role will help manage day to day activities of designated wholesaler(s); these include setting appointments, developing sales plans, providing marketplace feedback and assisting in the building of market strategies. Utilizes appropriate judgment to allocate financial resources from the assigned territory’s business development budget and acts as a catalyst to drive sales growth, build market share and meet necessary sales and asset targets for the TruStage Annuity products. This role will be based outside of the Madison office location.


Account Specialist - Possesses detailed knowledge and/or skill on a specific subject or activity relating to financial industry and TruStage Annuity product wholesaling. Their talents are devoted to a specific business focus, and they can provide guidance, mentorship, technical leadership and training to the team when appropriate. Develops and implements solutions that align with key business strategies and initiatives. Provide public speaking support within various territories. Conducts territory reviews with National Accounts and Broker Dealer relationships. Able to conduct F2F meetings on their own within their territory as needed. Will work to obtain additional industry related licenses, certificates and/or designations.

  • This is a focused, business-building position whose accountabilities will be accomplished through developing and expanding advisor relationships, educating, assisting and executing product sales programs and strategies via phone, virtual, and face to face channels.

Help develop and share ideas with investment advisors that increases sales; educate advisors on new product releases and enhancements; communicate economic and industry data relevant to the use of products; help develop recognition programs and ensure their effective administration. Develop strong relationships with field management, home office service, marketing, and investment advisory staff, as well as employees from various business areas, working to ensure effective communication between all parties.

In conjunction with the sales directors and product marketers, provide marketing support for project efforts, including development of new products or product enhancements, related training material revisions and product promotional efforts, and introduction campaigns.

Build and maintain strong knowledge of the entire TruStage Annuities product portfolio. Maintain a solid understanding of back-office processes for the investment advisor, broker/dealer operations, and the service areas, as well as a working knowledge of associated vendor relationships.

The above statement of duties is not intended to be all inclusive and other duties will be assigned from time to time.

About DoktorABC & Helfy

Helfy is a European leader in digital health, facilitating over 300,000 monthly treatments across the continent through our flagship platform, DoktorABC. We connect licensed physicians, partner pharmacies, and patients to provide high quality care and make healthcare faster, discreet, and reliable.

As we expand our footprint in the French market, we are looking for dedicated Independent General Practitioners to join our medical network. Responsibilities

  • 100% Remote Opportunity: Conduct consultations entirely remotely from home or your chosen workspace, wherever you are based, provided you hold valid authorization to practice in France.

Requirements

  • Licensing & Registration: Medical Doctor (MD) fully registered with the Conseil National de l’Ordre des Médecins (CNOM), holding an active RPPS number and legal authorization to practice medicine in France.

    • GLP-1 receptor agonist treatments for weight management and metabolic health.
  • Insurance: Active individual professional indemnity insurance (Responsabilité Civile Professionnelle – RCP) covering telemedicine activities for French patients.
  • Setup & Tech: Reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet and private space ensuring patient confidentiality, and a secure computer setup adhering to healthcare data security standards.
  • Communication: Professional, empathetic bedside manner well-suited for asynchronous reviews and video-based teleconsultations.

raw.description:
GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Risk Adjustment services, helping healthcare organizations optimize operations, improve financial performance, maintain compliance, and enhance the patient experience. Recognized as a KLAS® Top Performer, GeBBS combines innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence to deliver measurable results for clients across the healthcare industry. We are dedicated to being a trusted healthcare partner by upholding the highest standards of quality, information security, and compliance.

At GeBBS, we foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture where employees are empowered to develop their skills, advance their careers, and make a meaningful impact in transforming healthcare.

Responsibilities

The Authorization Representative will need to cover authorizations for all services (CT, MRI, echo, surgery, minor procedures, heart monitor, PFTs, sleep studies, IP, Observations, Swing Bed, ED, VA), excluding STAT requests.
Initial request and follow up required along with reporting of authorization status.

Prior Authorization and Eligibility

  • Initiate, submit, and track prior authorization requests across commercial and managed care payers.
  • Verify patient eligibility and benefits prior to authorization submission and confirm coverage, plan requirements, authorization thresholds, deductibles, copays, and other applicable benefit information.
  • Ensure authorization requests contain complete and accurate demographic, clinical, and supporting documentation.
  • Monitor pending authorization requests through payer portals and direct payer communication and proactively follow up through resolution.
  • Document authorization numbers, approved services, CPT codes, effective dates, expiration dates, session or visit limits, and other payer requirements.

Concurrent Reviews and Authorization Management

  • Manage concurrent review, continued stay, and authorization renewal requirements for ongoing services.
  • Track authorization limits and expiration dates and initiate renewals before existing authorizations are exhausted.
  • Maintain accurate authorization records and communicate pending or expiring authorizations to appropriate operational and clinical teams.
  • Help prevent gaps in authorization that could result in delayed services or lost reimbursement.

Denials and Appeals

  • Review authorization-related denials and determine whether the cause is clinical, administrative, eligibility-related, or procedural.
  • Coordinate appropriate corrective action and appeal activity within payer deadlines.
  • Prepare clear and accurate appeal documentation and coordinate with clinical and operational teams to obtain supporting information when required.
  • Track appeals through resolution and maintain complete documentation of outcomes.
  • Identify recurring denial trends and escalate systemic payer or process issues.

Payer and Revenue Cycle Coordination

  • Serve as a resource for payer authorization requirements, policies, portals, and workflows.
  • Maintain current knowledge of payer requirements and communicate material changes to appropriate teams.
  • Coordinate with billing, intake, clinical, credentialing, and contracting teams to resolve authorization-related reimbursement barriers.
  • Support single-case agreements, out-of-network authorization requests, and other payer authorization functions as needed.
  • Assist with payer audits and utilization management reviews by providing complete authorization records and supporting documentation.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and timely authorization activity within applicable EHR, practice management, and tracking systems.
  • Maintain payer authorization matrices and workflow documentation, including submission requirements, turnaround times, authorization limits, and renewal requirements.
  • Track authorization performance, including approval rates, denial rates, appeal outcomes, turnaround times, and outstanding requests.
  • Identify trends and recommend workflow improvements that strengthen revenue integrity and reduce preventable denials.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA and all applicable privacy and confidentiality requirements.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, with direct responsibility for prior authorization, eligibility and benefit verification, payer follow-up, or related revenue cycle functions.
  • Strong understanding of prior authorization requirements, payer timelines, submission processes, and authorization tracking.
  • Strong understanding of the differences between eligibility, benefits, authorization, and medical necessity requirements.
  • Experience working with commercial and managed care payers.
  • Experience using payer portals such asAvaility, NaviNet, and payer-specific platforms.
  • Working knowledge of CPT codes and their relationship to payer authorization requirements.
  • Experience managing denials and authorization appeals.
  • Experience with EHR, practice management, or other healthcare revenue cycle systems.

Requirements

  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple authorization queues and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with payer representatives and internal operational teams.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare privacy requirements.
  • CPC required. PACS preferred.
  • US based candidates eligible for employment without sponsorship.

At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone. Passionate about building insurance and financial services solutions, we push the boundaries of what’s possible. We need you to help us shape what’s next. You’ll be encouraged to share your experiences, ideas and skills to help others take control of their financial future.

Join a team that has received numerous awards for being a top place to work: TruStage awards and recognition

Job Purpose:


This position is responsible for the successful execution of account and territory strategies for assigned broker dealers distributing TruStage Annuities. This includes acquisition, optimization and retention of business. Provide strategic support to wholesalers to enhance their efforts of F2F product distribution through affiliated representatives and external broker dealers. Develop and implement strategic plans for business development with investment advisors and help manage the relationship with key managers with external broker dealers.

Employ consultative selling approach to support retail sales activities including increasing sales and market share objectives within an assigned geographic region. This role will help manage day to day activities of designated wholesaler(s); these include setting appointments, developing sales plans, providing marketplace feedback and assisting in the building of market strategies. Utilizes appropriate judgment to allocate financial resources from the assigned territory’s business development budget and acts as a catalyst to drive sales growth, build market share and meet necessary sales and asset targets for the TruStage Annuity products. This role will be based outside of the Madison office location.


Account Specialist - Possesses detailed knowledge and/or skill on a specific subject or activity relating to financial industry and TruStage Annuity product wholesaling. Their talents are devoted to a specific business focus, and they can provide guidance, mentorship, technical leadership and training to the team when appropriate. Develops and implements solutions that align with key business strategies and initiatives. Provide public speaking support within various territories. Conducts territory reviews with National Accounts and Broker Dealer relationships. Able to conduct F2F meetings on their own within their territory as needed. Will work to obtain additional industry related licenses, certificates and/or designations.


Ideal locations for the Internal Wholesaler would be in Central or Eastern states, but we can review those from Mountain, as well. Pacific would not be ideal, at this time.


Job Responsibilities:


  • This is a focused, business-building position whose accountabilities will be accomplished through developing and expanding advisor relationships, educating, assisting and executing product sales programs and strategies via phone, virtual, and face to face channels.
  • Continuously build, maintain and enhance positive business relationships within investment advisors offering TruStage Annuity products, serving as a resource for sales support for an assigned distribution channel and/or territory. Provide outbound support, including advising on the availability and appropriate use of TruStage Annuity products, literature and sales tools. Help develop and share ideas with investment advisors that increases sales; educate advisors on new product releases and enhancements; communicate economic and industry data relevant to the use of products; help develop recognition programs and ensure their effective administration. Document field contact through established contact management tools, utilizing contact data to enhance the level of field support and improve decision-making.
  • Provide support, including answering product questions; following up on requests for information and proposals; support product education; and providing timely responses to problems encountered in the field. Serve as a troubleshooter and problem solver for advisors on product and process issues and maintain a strong knowledge of available corporate resources, referring advisors to appropriate areas as necessary to ensure problem resolution.
  • As needed, provide marketing support for advisors through periodic participation in field schools, training meetings, and sales conventions. Help design and deliver product sessions and marketing presentations; participate in product marketing booths at conventions or trade shows; and demonstrate product sales tools and concepts at meetings. Develop strong relationships with field management, home office service, marketing, and investment advisory staff, as well as employees from various business areas, working to ensure effective communication between all parties.
  • Provide proactive sales and marketing support to one or more Regional Vice Presidents, Wholesalers and/or product marketers. This support includes partnering in the development and execution of marketing plans; allocating funding for business development programs; providing sales strategies; implementing sales call procedures; provide product education and developing recognition campaigns for face-to-face representatives. Follow up on requests for information from product managers or marketers and analyze internal business information; industry and economic data; and competitive information, utilizing that data to provide effective marketing support. In conjunction with the sales directors and product marketers, provide marketing support for project efforts, including development of new products or product enhancements, related training material revisions and product promotional efforts, and introduction campaigns.
  • Maintain and build strong product knowledge, including any related economic, industry and competitor’s information. Build and maintain strong knowledge of the entire TruStage Annuities product portfolio. Maintain a solid understanding of back-office processes for the investment advisor, broker/dealer operations, and the service areas, as well as a working knowledge of associated vendor relationships.

The above statement of duties is not intended to be all inclusive and other duties will be assigned from time to time.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance or equivalent trade off in professional work experience.
  • 2+ years of sales, marketing or customer service experience in the financial industry.
  • Strong knowledge of investment and/or insurance products.
  • Demonstrated sales & marketing knowledge of annuities and variable products, and their appropriate applications within the context of a needs-based sales process.
  • FINRA Securities Industry Essentials Examination, Series 6 or 7 and 63 licenses required. Life and Variable Licenses required or can complete all licenses/registrations within 90 days
  • Industry designations a plus (CPA, CFA, ChFC, CLU, etc.)
  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Capable of presenting technical product knowledge with professional phone and face to face skills
  • Exercise sound judgment and solid decision making for allocating company resources for business development.
  • Highly motivated and able to work independently and perform under pressure. Proven ability to grow a sales territory.
  • Ability and desire to spend significant portion of job developing relationships virtually and over the phone.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment. Strong territory management, independence and organizational skills.
  • Working knowledge of office automation tools; experience with contact management tools a plus.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%.
