  • India – Entertainment & Content Integrations
    Expanding into the world’s largest film and OTT markets, we are establishing our Mumbai-based operations focused on in-film brand integrations, OTT partnerships, and branded entertainment solutions. Supported by our AI-driven placement and analytics platform, we connect brands with audiences through story-driven content integrations that deliver measurable impact.

To know more about us our websites at -I

Role Overview

If you’ve ever seen your favourite superstar sipping a cola, speaking on a phone, or enjoying a snack on screen — know that it wasn’t by chance, it was by choice. Your choice. You were the one instrumental in making sure the talent showcased the brand, and in closing the deal that brought that brand into the heart of the story.

At Sky Blue Media, we believe in creating these moments with purpose. As Sales, Business Development & Brand Partnerships resource, you will play a decisive role in shaping how brands appear in films and beyond. This is where business development meets creativity — forging partnerships with production houses, agencies, and brands to deliver integrations that are impactful, seamless, and memorable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Map your market (your region) for various brands, and their agencies.

  • Understand brand’s positing and upcoming campaigns.

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities for in-film brand integrations, co-branded promotions, and other media alliances.

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with various brand’s top management and their agency’s SPOCS.

  • Understand the film project, its scope, nuances, star casts, its plot and films setup (Theatrical films, OTT projects or TV serials)

  • Conceptualize creative brand solutions aligned with film storylines and target audiences.

  • Regularly and diligently, stay connected with brands and agencies to pitch SkyBlue Cinematix and the projects.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to create and pitch compelling proposals, presentations, and case studies.

  • Work closely with media planning and buying teams to align integrations with larger campaign strategies.

  • Negotiate and finalize deals ensuring win-win outcomes for both brand and production stakeholders.

  • Stay updated with industry trends, film releases, OTT content pipelines, and brand marketing calendars.

  • Coordinate with creative and content teams to ensure smooth delivery of brand integrations and campaigns.

  • Track performance metrics, prepare post-integration reports, and ensure client satisfaction and retention.

  • Conceptualize and pitch bold, customized partnership models that fuse brand storytelling with cinematic moments.

  • Collaborate with internal creative, marketing, legal, and production experts to deliver seamless, integrated experiences on and off screen.

  • Track the pulse of entertainment trends, OTT innovation, and consumer engagement formats to keep our offerings unmatched.

  • Work with internal teams (e.g., creative, marketing, sales) to develop and execute joint campaigns and create co-branded marketing materials.

Ideal Profile

  • 8 years plus of proven success in business development, sales, brand partnerships, brand solutions or strategic partnerships within media, entertainment, or advertising.

  • A deal-closer with a track-record of securing multi-crore, multi-film/franchise partnerships.

  • Deep relationships with Brand managers, agencies, and production houses — your phonebook is an industry goldmine.

  • Independent hustler who thrives on accountability, targets, and creating impact.

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills that inspire confidence and excitement.

  • MBA/PG in Marketing, Media, or Business preferred.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity to grow your skills and make a significant contribution to our team. You'll work in a supportive and collaborative environment that values creativity and professional development.

SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve.

At SitusAMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team!

The Associate, Systems Administrator is an individual contributor in the Systems Administration job family, responsible for the implementation, administration, and ongoing support of the organization's server and platform infrastructure. This individual is an experienced administrator on the systems administration team: applying and helping refine build and hardening standards, resolving escalations from the service desk and Analyst-level administrators, and providing day-to-day guidance to less experienced staff. The Associate is responsible for the day-to-day administration of assigned platforms, including patch cadence, capacity, performance, and input into upgrade and lifecycle planning, and works independently on defined problems, escalating novel or high-risk decisions to senior staff. This role requires a degree of flexibility and collaborative working both within Technology and across the firm.Essential Job Functions:
  • Serve as an escalation point (Tier 2/3) for server, platform, and infrastructure issues referred by the service desk and Analyst-level administrators, escalating to senior staff or vendors where required.
  • Support infrastructure workstreams on site and project development efforts, providing solution design input, effort estimates, and technical risk assessment during the planning phase.
  • Gather and document system requirements across project teams and support the infrastructure build, cutover, and transition of new products and services into post-launch operations throughout the life of the product or service.
  • Maintain the patch and release cadence for assigned platforms; author change records, including risk assessment and rollback plans, and present them at the Change Advisory Board.
  • Administer the Kiteworks platform, including secure transfer policy configuration and enforcement, vendor escalation, and escalated end-user support.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with your technical peers as well as non-technical staff.
  • Maintain build standards, hardening baselines, runbooks, and technical procedures for assigned platforms, and contribute updates as systems and configurations change.
  • Perform trouble resolution fixes remotely or in person, including installing and upgrading software, installing hardware, and configuring systems and applications.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance to Analyst-level administrators and review their work for technical accuracy and standards compliance.
  • Configure and maintain monitoring, alerting, and performance baselines for business-critical systems, and perform capacity planning and tuning to prevent delays and outages. Other activities as may be assigned by your manager.
  • Support restoration efforts on Severity 1 and 2 infrastructure incidents; contribute to root cause analyses and complete assigned corrective actions.
  • Develop and maintain automation and orchestration scripts (PowerShell, Python, Terraform) that standardize routine administration tasks.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    • Advanced knowledge of systems hardware, software, and system administration.

    • Experience guiding junior administrators and reviewing their work.

raw.excerpt: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy.
raw.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About this role:

As a Lead Data Analyst, you will report directly to the VP of Analytics & Operations Supply and act as the team's senior individual contributor on the hardest and most ambiguous analytical problems across Liftoff's supply side. You will act as a technical and strategic thought leader, defining best practices for analytics, and mentoring analysts on technical rigor, problem-solving, and strategic insight development. This role demands technical depth, strong business acumen, and leadership skills to drive impact across multiple teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive analysis and insight generation on highly complex, ambiguous business and technical questions; influence roadmap and operational decisions at a senior level.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL queries for large-scale datasets (billions of rows), developing reproducible analytics workflows.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and triage technical issues at the intersection of product performance and business KPIs.
  • Build and automate dashboards, ad-hoc analysis tools, and internal reporting pipelines using SQL, Looker, and/or Tableau.
  • Translate highly technical concepts (e.g., ML model changes, SDK upgrades, auction mechanics) into business impact analysis for Commercial teams and leadership.
  • Lead transformational projects end-to-end, from ideation and scoping through technical execution and operational rollout.
  • Mentor other analysts on technical best practices, business context, and effective communication.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Finance teams to drive initiatives forward.

Requirements:

  • B.A./B.S. degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in data analytics, consulting, or business analytics roles, preferably in high-tech or AdTech.
  • Expertise writing complex, performance-optimized SQL on massive datasets; experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Trino).
  • Solid grounding in statistical inference, A/B test design, and causal reasoning; comfortable with confidence intervals, statistical power, and the failure modes of noisy experiments.
  • Proficiency with Looker, Tableau, or similar BI tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous business problems into structured analyses leading to actionable recommendations.
  • Can connect a technical finding to revenue, margin, and partner impact without being told how.
  • Strong written and verbal skills; able to tailor technical concepts for a range of audiences from engineering to C-level leadership. Consulting-style structured presentation skills: you can build a narrative, defend a recommendation, and handle pushback in the room.
  • Ability to mentor others, lead cross-functional projects, and drive organizational change through data insights.

Location:

This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA.

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City.

Travel Expectations:

We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:

Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.

The following are our base salary ranges for multiple levels:

  • SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, NYC, Seattle: $165,000 - $195,000
  • Olympia, Austin, San Diego, Santa Barbara, Boston: $152,000 - $179,000
  • All other cities and towns in our approved states: $142,000 - $167,000

Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.

Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.

Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:

Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.

raw.description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Associate of Search Engine Optimization (SEO) works closely with the Manager of SEO to execute established SEO and AI Search strategies across a multi-location client portfolio. This role focuses on high-quality content writing and optimization, technical and local SEO execution, performance analysis, and timely delivery of program deliverables. The ideal candidate manages multiple projects efficiently, communicates effectively with clients and stakeholders, and adapts to emerging search tactics and best practices.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Execute SEO Tactics: Implement established on-page, off-page, technical, and local SEO tactics, including keyword optimization, schema markup, website content updates, and AI Search optimization to improve organic visibility.
  • Content Development and Optimization: Write, edit, and optimize high-quality website content, including landing pages, FAQs, SEO content briefs, and other SEO deliverables, applying E-E-A-T principles, search intent, and AI Search best practices.
  • Monitor and Report on SEO Performance: Analyze SEO metrics and KPIs, translating performance data into actionable insights for clients and stakeholders.
  • Educate Clients and Stakeholders: Communicate SEO best practices, emerging trends, and results to clients and internal teams.
  • Manage Multiple Projects: Manage a high volume of property deliverables simultaneously while maintaining quality, accuracy, and deadlines.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with content, paid, social, web development, and other digital marketing channels to support integrated organic marketing efforts.
  • Adapt to the Dynamic Digital Landscape: Stay current on SEO and AI-powered search developments; support testing, process improvements, and new practices that increase program effectiveness and efficiency. Collaborate with preferred partners on relevant SEO tests.

BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or comparable experience in marketing, communications, advertising, general business, or a related field. 2+ years’ experience in marketing with a focus on organic search. Previous agency experience is ideal.
  • Solid knowledge of on-page, off-page, technical, and local SEO, AI Search optimization, keyword research, schema markup, and SEO tools such as BrightEdge, SEMrush, and SEO Clarity.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SEO and digital marketing copywriting, with exceptional writing and editing skills and an understanding of E-E-A-T, search intent, and content for traditional and AI-powered search.
  • Experience using AI-assisted content tools to support SEO workflows, with editorial judgment to ensure accuracy, originality, brand consistency, and quality.
  • Working knowledge of Google analytics and tracking tools, including Google Tag Manager and Looker Studio. Google Analytics certification is strongly desired.
  • Experience updating content and implementing technical SEO improvements across CMS platforms. Sitecore experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO), user experience, and A/B testing is a plus.
  • Preferred: Experience executing cross-channel organic marketing initiatives, including organic social media, Google Business Profile optimization, local listing management, and content distribution.
  • Strong organization, time management, problem-solving, and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to explain SEO performance and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional colleagues, external vendors, and business leaders.
  • Comfortable using digital collaboration and productivity tools, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, email, and virtual meeting software.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS

  • Maintain a current knowledge of the Company’s marketing function’s infrastructure, platforms, marketing products, programs, and strategies currently in place, and the established policies, protocols, standards, and other requirements related to marketing and the Greystar brand. Stay up to date on preferred marketing vendors and suppliers, including external creative agencies, and stay informed about initiatives and priorities related to digital marketing.
  • Build, establish, and access a network of experts and professionals inside and outside of the multifamily real estate industry and attend or participate in conferences, professional associations, and other events that contribute to professional growth. Set and communication standards for team member participation in activities that support their professional growth and development and discipline expertise.
  • Follow and oversee team member compliance with the Company’s established operating, systems, financial, and human resources policies and procedures, and meet Company and departmental standards and requirements related to job performance.
  • Personally practice proper safety techniques, follow the Company’s risk and safety policies and procedures, and immediately report any team member or visitor injuries, accidents, or other safety-related issues to the appropriate individual(s). Ensure team member awareness of and compliance with safety protocols and procedures.
  • Continually identify and act on opportunities for improving the level and quality of service provided by the National Marketing and Digital Marketing functions, and lead efforts that improve their efficiency, effectiveness, productivity, and overall contributions to the Company.

TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Team members work in an office or remote work environment. No special physical demands are required.
  • Rare or occasional travel may be required to attend business meetings, training programs, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Job demands may require long periods of sitting
  • Travel required 10% to attend business meetings, training programs, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.

The salary range for this position is $63,000 - $67,000.


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

*Benefits offered for full-time employees. For Union and Prevailing Wage roles, compensation and benefits may vary from the listed information above due to Collective Bargaining Agreements and/or local governing authority.


Greystar will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Greystar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


This position may be performed remotely anywhere within the United States except the state of Alaska.


Important Notice: Greystar will never request your banking details or other sensitive personal information during the interview process. Greystar does not conduct any interviews via text or messaging, and all communication will come from official Greystar email addresses (@greystar.com). raw.description:
KPMG* — міжнародна мережа незалежних фірм, що надають аудиторські, податкові та консультаційні послуги. Познайомитися з KPMG в Україні детальніше можна за посиланням.
KPMG в Україні входить до переліку 50 найкращих роботодавців за версією Forbes (2023-2024 роки) та до переліку 5 найкращих роботодавців для молоді у сфері аудиту та консалтингу за версією опитування серед студентів проведеного бренд агенцією UGEN у 2023 - 2024 роках. В березні 2025 року KPMG в Україні приєдналася до когорти компаній-лідерів, які першими підписали Принципи бізнесу, дружнього до ветеранів і ветеранок. Також, нас включено до переліку платників податків з високим рівнем добровільного дотримання податкового законодавства (так званого «Білого клубу»).

Зараз ми в пошуку Молодшого (-ої) спеціаліста (-ки) з управління ризиками, що прагне розвиватися в цій сфері та стати частиною команди професіоналів!

Чому варто до нас приєднатися? Бо ми пропонуємо:

  • Роботу в командах, що створюють сенси;
  • Доступ до внутрішнього та зовнішнього навчання, що сприяє розвитку професійних навичок;
  • Участь у національних проєктах відбудови країни;
  • Сервіс психологічної підтримки (збільшена кількість консультацій для мобілізованих, ветеранів та тих, хто чекає);
  • Медичне страхування (розширена опція страхування для ветеранів);
  • 29 календарних днів відпустки;
  • 5 додаткових оплачуваних днів турботи про своє здоров’я;
  • Вебінари добробуту, книжковий клуб, жіноча спільнота та спільнота донорів крові;
  • Можливість працювати віддалено або у комфортному офісі в центрі міста;
  • Благодійну діяльність та волонтерство, допомогу вразливим групам, турботу про тварин та зелений офіс;
  • Офіційна заробітна плата з відрахуванням податків;
  • Цікаві виклики та прозорі умови зростання;
  • Донати та внесок в перемогу.

Основні обов’язки:

  • Проведення перевірки клієнтів у межах процедур KYC (Know Your Customer), аналіз та верифікація отриманих документів;

  • Перевірка та оцінка наявних клієнтів відповідно до встановлених політик і процедур;
  • Опрацювання та аналіз великих обсягів інформації з різних джерел.

Вимоги до кандидата/кандидатки:

  • Випускник/випускниця або студент/студентка останнього курсу з можливістю працювати повний робочий день;
  • Досвід роботи з KYC буде перевагою, але не є обов’язковим;
  • Розвинені навички пошуку, опрацювання та аналізу великих обсягів інформації, вміння робити обґрунтовані висновки;
  • Рівень англійської мови Upper-Intermediate або вище, впевнені навички усної та письмової комунікації;
  • Аналітичне мислення, уважність до деталей та допитливість;
  • Бажання навчатися та професійно розвиватися;
  • Хороші навички планування та тайм-менеджменту;
  • Здатність працювати самостійно та ефективно взаємодіяти з іншими підрозділами.

Прийняти Job Offer – означає приєднатися до розмаїтої команди KPMG в Україні, проявляти свою індивідуальність і реалізовувати свій потенціал.

KPMG в Україні створює робоче середовище, де кожен має можливості для розвитку та побудови кар’єри: компанія дотримується принципу нульової толерантності до будь-яких проявів дискримінації за ознаками віку, статі, сексуальної орієнтації чи інвалідності. Ми поважаємо різноманіття думок і досвіду, адже переконані - працюючи разом, люди з різними знаннями та поглядами генерують більше креативних ідей, знаходять кращі рішення та розробляють інноваційні продукти.

* KPMG — це бренд, під яким працюють і надають професійні послуги фірми-члени KPMG International Limited («KPMG International»). «KPMG» використовується для позначення окремих фірм-членів мережі KPMG або однієї чи кількох фірм-членів разом. Кожна фірма є незалежною юридичною особою. Кожна фірма-член KPMG несе відповідальність за своїми зобов’язаннями. raw.description:
Job Family:

Risk & Regulatory Compliance Consulting

Travel Required:

None

Clearance Required:

Ability to Obtain Public Trust

What You Will Do:

This role is responsible for conducting identity fraud investigations, reviewing account and identity information, analyzing potentially fraudulent activity, and making investigative determinations in accordance with established procedures and program requirements. The Fraud Investigator will leverage investigative tools, available data, and established investigative methodologies to identify indicators of identity fraud, document findings, and support appropriate case outcomes. The role requires strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to effectively manage investigative caseloads in a production-driven environment.

  • Conduct investigations of suspected identity fraud, identity misuse, account compromise, and other potentially fraudulent activity.
  • Review identity, account, transactional, and other relevant information to identify fraud indicators, inconsistencies, and patterns requiring further investigation.
  • Use investigative and identity verification tools, including LexisNexis and Socure, as applicable, to research identities and inform investigative determinations.
  • Analyze available evidence and make timely, well-supported investigative determinations in accordance with established procedures and program requirements.
  • Document investigative steps, findings, supporting evidence, and case determinations clearly and consistently within applicable case management systems.
  • Manage assigned investigative caseloads and meet established production, timeliness, and quality expectations.
  • Escalate complex cases, emerging fraud patterns, procedural questions, and potential control gaps to team leadership as appropriate.
  • Identify recurring fraud trends, investigative challenges, and opportunities to strengthen fraud detection and investigation processes.
  • Collaborate with fellow investigators, team leads, and other stakeholders to resolve complex cases and promote consistent investigative practices.
  • Participate in case reviews, calibration sessions, and team discussions to support consistent application of investigative procedures and decisioning standards.
  • As needed, draft, maintain, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), job aids, investigative guidance, and other operational documentation.
  • As needed, develop training materials and conduct onboarding, refresher, or targeted training for investigators on investigative procedures, tools, fraud trends, and operational best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives intended to strengthen investigative effectiveness, efficiency, and consistency across fraud operations.

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse.
  • Due to contract requirements, candidates must be U.S. Citizens and reside within the United States.
  • Bachelor's degree
  • One (1) to Five (5) Years of experience conducting risk assessment (e.g., risk scoring, control evaluation).
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • o Identity fraud investigations
  • o Fraud investigations or fraud operations
  • o Identity verification or identity proofing
  • o Account or identity-related investigative research
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to evaluate multiple sources of information and reach well-supported investigative conclusions.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to conduct investigations accurately and consistently while adhering to established procedures.
  • Ability to clearly document investigative findings, evidence, and case determinations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify and escalate unusual fraud patterns, emerging risks, and complex investigative scenarios.
  • Experience working in a production-based, metrics-driven, or quota-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple investigations and competing priorities.

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • Experience using investigative and identity verification tools such as LexisNexis or similar fraud detection and identity verification platforms.
  • Experience investigating identity theft, synthetic identity fraud, account takeover, or other forms of identity-related fraud.
  • Familiarity with identity proofing, account verification, fraud prevention, and case management processes.
  • Experience identifying fraud trends or patterns across investigative cases.
  • Experience developing SOPs, job aids, investigative guidance, or other operational documentation.
  • Experience facilitating training, coaching, or knowledge-sharing sessions for investigators.
The annual salary range for this position is $74,000.00-$124,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

raw.description:
Join us in redefining what it means to work for a CRO.

When you work at Rho, it’s more than just a job—you become part of the Rho Factor. We’re a proud bunch of science nerds who love tackling big challenges together. We’re not your typical CRO, and we’re not trying to be. Here, curiosity is encouraged, fresh approaches are welcome, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do.

Whether you’re a data wizard, analytical genius, project mastermind, or any other role, you’ll fit right into the equation of the Rho Factor. Expect plenty of geeky jokes, eccentric personalities, spontaneous brainstorms, and a supportive community where people genuinely care about their work—and each other.

You’ll have the opportunity to experience a thriving company with real stability - financial, workforce, and corporate, which has created a safe environment to innovate and develop over a long and rewarding career.

This is your opportunity to join Rho as a Senior Safety Specialist - we are open to this role being located in Poland, UK, or Spain. This is a remote opportunity.

Product Safety Team professionals are integral for the case management of federally and commercially funded clinical studies. While ensuring adherence to study protocols and internal SOPS, this team prepares safety-related documentation, oversees day-to-day activities, manages end-to-end case processing, and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders.

What You Will Be Doing:

Study Management & Support

  • Serves as primary Product Safety Lead for assigned studies of moderate to high complexity, operating independently within defined scope and procedural frameworks
  • Leads study-level safety governance, including planning, execution, and oversight of safety data collection, processing, and reporting activities
  • Develops, authors, and maintains study-specific Safety Management Plans, ensuring alignment with protocol requirements, sponsor expectations, and internal procedural documents
  • Acts as the primary Product Safety contact for sponsors and internal project teams; manages day-to-day safety-related communications and issue resolution
  • Chairs or leads study-level safety meetings, prepares content, documents decisions, and tracks action items to completion
  • Manages study-level safety scope, timelines, and budgets; identifies and escalates risks that may impact deliverables, quality, or compliance Oversees safety start-up and close-out activities, ensuring inspection-ready documentation and adherence to internal SOPs and project-specific requirements
  • Provides guidance to Product Safety Specialists and Associates supporting the study, including review of deliverables and escalation of complex issues
  • Supports proposal development and bid defenses by contributing study-level safety strategy and operational input
  • Conduct preliminary or routine risk assessments to identify potential safety or process risks and escalate findings for review and action by senior/lead team members
  • Participates in training and mentoring junior safety team members, helping to develop and deliver training content, providing skill-building support and guidance on best practices

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (e.g., RN, Health Sciences, PharmD) or equivalent combination of education and relevant product safety or clinical research experience along with 5+ years of product safety/pharmacovigilance experience
  • 2 years of experience working as a Product Safety Lead on Clinical Trials is required, including developing Safety Management Plans and site training materials and supporting inspections
  • Experience with Argus is preferred; proficient in the use of business productivity software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Strong knowledge of safety data collection, processing and reporting requirements; strong knowledge of global regulatory requirements for pharmacovigilance; advanced knowledge of safety database applications and MedDRA/WHO Drug coding
  • Effective verbal and written communication and presentation skills with proficiency in both English and local language, with the ability to convey complex or nuanced information clearly across diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively within a team environment
  • Exercises strong judgment in complex or ambiguous situations by weighing risks, considering multiple perspectives, and making decisions that balance accuracy, timeliness, and broader implications.
  • Exhibits advanced detail orientation by proactively identifying issues, inconsistencies, or risks and
  • by ensuring work products are thorough, reliable, and aligned with broader objectives.

raw.description:
about us: battleface is building a humanity-focused travel insurance company to bring people and the world together. For too long, travel insurance has centered on the company and not the traveler. We’re changing that by connecting people with customized coverage at the right price, exactly when and where they need it.

Our global assistance arm, Robin Assist, powers the 24/7 support, medical coordination, and claims services that travelers rely on — not just for battleface, but across the industry. Together, we’re setting new standards for how travelers are cared for worldwide.

about the role: we're looking for a Payments & Recovery Specialist to manage international medical provider payments, investigate questionable invoices, negotiate medical bills, and pursue recovery and subrogation opportunities on behalf of our insurance partners.

This is not a traditional accounts payable position. We're looking for someone who can investigate, negotiate, challenge costs, and take ownership of complex cases involving hospitals, medical providers, insurers, legal representatives, and third-party administrators around the world.

You'll work closely with our Medical Assistance, Claims, Finance, and Fraud teams to ensure invoices are legitimate, charges are reasonable, payments are accurate, and recovery opportunities are pursued.

The right person is analytical, commercially minded, detail-oriented, and comfortable challenging providers when something doesn't add up. You'll need to be confident communicating with international hospitals, negotiating settlements, investigating potential fraud, and managing cases through to resolution.

what you'll do:

Medical Provider Payments & Invoice Management

  • Review and validate medical invoices from hospitals, clinics, physicians, and other healthcare providers worldwide.
  • Verify patient details, treatment dates, medical services, invoice accuracy, and supporting documentation.
  • Review medical charges for reasonableness, identify duplicate billing, inflated costs, unnecessary services, and billing discrepancies.
  • Negotiate medical bills, discounts, and full-and-final settlements with international providers.
  • Coordinate payments with Finance, ensuring invoices are approved, properly documented, and paid within agreed timelines.
  • Verify international banking instructions, beneficiary details, SWIFT/IBAN information, and payment requirements before releasing payments.
  • Maintain accurate payment records, track outstanding invoices, and resolve provider payment disputes.
  • Ensure applicable deductibles, patient responsibilities, and agreed discounts are correctly applied.

Cost Containment & Provider Negotiations

  • Research local medical pricing and benchmark charges against reasonable and customary costs.
  • Negotiate directly with hospitals, medical networks, and billing intermediaries to reduce medical expenses.
  • Review high-value medical invoices and challenge questionable treatment costs, procedures, and lengths of stay.
  • Identify opportunities to improve provider payment terms and negotiate better commercial arrangements.
  • Track negotiated savings and report cost containment results to management and insurance partners.
  • Escalate unusual billing patterns, excessive charges, or suspected provider misconduct.

Recovery & Subrogation

  • Identify opportunities to recover medical and claims expenses from responsible third parties, insurers, and other sources.
  • Investigate liability involving accidents, hotels, transportation providers, medical facilities, and other third parties.
  • Coordinate recovery efforts with liability insurers, legal representatives, and international claims organizations.
  • Review accident reports, police documentation, insurance policies, medical records, and other evidence supporting recovery.
  • Pursue coordination of benefits and recoveries from primary or overlapping insurance coverage.
  • Prepare recovery demands, negotiate settlements, and track outstanding recovery balances.
  • Work with external legal counsel when formal recovery or litigation is required.
  • Maintain accurate subrogation records and report recovery results to insurance partners.

Fraud Prevention & Invoice Verification

  • Investigate potentially fraudulent medical invoices, fabricated documentation, and suspicious payment requests.
  • Independently verify hospital legitimacy, provider credentials, patient admissions, and medical billing information.
  • Identify suspicious patterns involving repeat admissions, inflated treatment charges, altered invoices, and unusual payment arrangements.
  • Conduct provider due diligence using independent sources, official records, and direct hospital verification.
  • Collaborate with our Fraud and Claims teams to investigate suspicious claims and recommend appropriate action.
  • Document investigation findings and maintain clear evidence supporting payment or recovery decisions.

Reporting & Operational Improvement

  • Maintain accurate records of payments, negotiations, recoveries, and investigations in our claims management systems.
  • Monitor outstanding payment obligations, recovery opportunities, and overdue cases.
  • Prepare regular reporting on payment volumes, negotiated savings, recovery performance, and suspected fraud.
  • Identify process improvements and opportunities to automate invoice review, verification, and payment workflows.
  • Support the development of internal procedures for international provider payments, cost containment, and subrogation.

what we're looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience in travel insurance, medical assistance, claims administration, healthcare billing, cost containment, or insurance recoveries.
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating medical invoices, ideally involving international healthcare providers.
  • Understanding of insurance claims, medical billing, subrogation, and coordination of benefits.
  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence challenging unreasonable charges and resolving disputes.
  • Familiarity with international payments, banking verification, and cross-border transactions.
  • Ability to review medical documentation, financial records, and insurance policies.
  • Strong investigative and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and managing multiple complex cases simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with claims management systems, spreadsheets, and digital collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to work across international time zones and communicate with providers worldwide.

nice to have:

  • Experience working for a travel insurance company, third-party administrator (TPA), medical assistance company, or international medical cost containment organization.
  • Previous responsibility for medical bill negotiation, provider fraud investigations, or subrogation recoveries.
  • Familiarity with international healthcare systems and medical pricing.
  • Experience working with external legal counsel and liability insurers.
  • Additional languages, particularly Spanish, French, or Portuguese.
  • Experience using AI tools, document analysis, and automated verification systems.

what success looks like:

  • Medical invoices are reviewed, verified, and processed accurately and on time.
  • Unreasonable medical charges are challenged and negotiated before payment.
  • Provider relationships are maintained while protecting our insurance partners from unnecessary costs.
  • Recovery and subrogation opportunities are identified early and actively pursued.
  • Suspicious invoices and fraudulent payment requests are identified before funds are released.
  • Payment backlogs are minimized, and every outstanding case has a clear next action.
  • Measurable savings and recoveries are delivered to our insurance partners.

why join us:

  • You'll be joining a fast-growing international insurance and assistance business where your work has a direct financial and operational impact.
  • You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of complex international cases, negotiate with providers around the world, develop recovery strategies, and help build smarter, technology-driven payment and fraud prevention processes.
  • We're looking for someone who takes initiative, solves problems, and doesn't need to be told what to do next. If you enjoy investigating complex cases, negotiating solutions, and finding ways to make insurance operations more effective, we'd like to hear from you.

Cardinal Health™ WaveMark™ Solutions, is a market leader in healthcare inventory automation and analytics providing a scalable, enterprise-level, cloud-based platform that integrates with clinical and financial systems. For more than 20 years, WaveMark™ has helped health systems automate and simplify clinical and supply chain workflows, enabling clinicians to spend less time managing supplies and more time focused on patient care.

Job Summary


The Sr. Product Manager is responsible for understanding healthcare supply chain workflows, market dynamics, customer needs, and emerging innovations to develop workflow strategies and lead product development initiatives that enable business growth. The role defines customer problems and desired outcomes, evaluates market and portfolio expansion opportunities, translates validated opportunities into product concepts and requirements, and leads complex projects from discovery and business case through POC, pilot, ideation and collaborates with Platform Product Management for product delivery and commercialization, launch, adoption, and optimization.


This individual contributor applies advanced product, healthcare supply chain, and technical knowledge and leads through influence with no required direct reports. The role works closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data & Analytics, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, Finance, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, and external vendor or supplier partners to deliver differentiated workflow advancements aligned to the product portfolio strategy.


Responsibilities


Supply Chain Workflow Strategy and Market Development

  • Research healthcare supply chain workflows, customer needs, market trends, projections, competitive dynamics, and emerging innovations to define unmet needs and leading-edge product opportunities.
  • Develop workflow strategies and product concepts that advance supply chain intelligence, automation, efficiency, visibility, and clinical or operational integration for healthcare providers.
  • Evaluate portfolio expansion opportunities using market size, barriers to entry, differentiated value, regulatory assessment, portfolio alignment, customer value, and business growth potential.

Product Concept, Requirements, and Business Case

  • Translate validated workflow opportunities into product concepts, target outcomes, detailed requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable success criteria using agile methodologies.
  • Develop and present business cases and stage-gate recommendations, including value proposition, market opportunity, investment, financial assumptions, risks, dependencies, and strategic fit.
  • Use customer evidence, prototypes, pilots, analytics, and technical feasibility to refine requirements and recommend build, partner, buy, scale, iterate, or defer decisions.

Product Development and Commercialization

  • Lead complex product development projects of large scope from initiation through closing, independently determining methods while aligning to overall project objectives, timelines, quality, investment, and desired outcomes.
  • Establish or coordinate commercialization strategies including product pro forma, branding and sales strategy inputs, communication vehicles, training, pilot-site deployment, customer engagement, and launch readiness in partnership with accountable functions.
  • Coordinate Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and other stakeholders through requirement, POC, development, validation, launch, and adoption.

Launch, Growth, and Continuous Improvement

  • Operationalize product launches through coordinated customer engagement, implementation readiness, enablement, support, adoption planning, and performance monitoring as required.
  • Monitor customer adoption, workflow value, market response, quality, financial performance, and product outcomes; translate evidence into optimization, expansion, or lifecycle recommendations.
  • Recommend new practices, processes, metrics, models, policies, or procedures that improve product development effectiveness and may set precedent; mentor less experienced colleagues.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred.
  • 8+ years' experience in product management, preferred.
  • Strong Agile product development experience and ability to work effectively with engineering, design, architecture, data, security, privacy, quality, regulatory, legal, procurement, finance, and operations.
  • Healthcare supply chain, inventory management, ERP experience, medical device, or clinical experience preferred.
  • Strong analytical, writing, facilitation, presentation, negotiation, relationship management, and stakeholder leadership skills.
  • Ability to travel approximately 20–30%, based on product, and customer needs.
  • Customer/Vendor credentialing may be required (this may include vaccinations)--additional details will be provided if selected for the interview process.

What is expected of you and others at this level


  • Applies advanced knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects
  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals
  • Recommends new practices, processes, metrics, or models
  • Works on or may lead complex projects of large scope
  • Projects may have significant and long-term impact
  • Provides solutions which may set precedent
  • Independently determines method for completion of new projects
  • Receives guidance on overall project objectives
  • Acts as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

Anticipated salary range: $125,300-161,010

Bonus eligible: Yes

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan

  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

Customer Contract Principal I

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

JOB SUMMARY

Owns and manages the contracts process and works proactively with Project Leads and Business Development in the development and execution of contract documents with a primary focus on customer satisfaction. Drives identified corporate targets and departmental goals through active workload management and prioritization. Identifies project and/or individual contract-related risks and provides swift resolution to ensure timely execution of contracts and change orders.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintains ownership of and manages contract process to ensure timely delivery and execution consistent with standard cycle times, including but not limited to, the coordination and finalization of the contractual instrument to align with defined scope of work.
  • Leads the negotiation and preparation of both financial and contractual terms within complex customer agreements, identifying financial risks, assessing budget impacts, and validating all contract changes to ensure alignment with internal standards. Provides clear analysis and recommendations to internal stakeholders and Project Leads, proactively communicates financial and contractual issues, escalates material deviations to leadership, and remains engaged with Customers and internal teams until all terms are fully resolved and agreed upon.
  • Collaborates closely with the Pricing and Proposals teams to finalize budgets and financial models, and presents financial terms to customers with a strong command of internal financial policies. Effectively negotiates with Customers to achieve mutually acceptable financial outcomes and proactively escalates material deviations to leadership, remaining engaged until resolution.
  • Drives quarterly contracting targets through active workload management and prioritization and setting of plans for delivery and execution. Contributes to team effort and takes self-initiative to accomplish individual targets that align with quarterly departmental goals.
  • Develops internal stakeholder relationships and works independently with Project Leads, Business Development, and Customer on assigned projects. Attends face-to-face meetings or calls with Project Leads and Customers as needed to ensure timely execution of contract.
  • Updates and maintains timely records in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system and Contract Management System based on Customer Contract Management (CCM) processes throughout the day on a daily basis.
  • Works consistently within the department’s metrics/timelines for completion of documents and related tasks.
  • Follows all CCM review processes and strives to consistently deliver a quality product to both internal stakeholders and external Customers. Evaluates contracts for completeness and accuracy by comparing to department guidelines to determine adherence and ensures that corrections are appropriately made and documented to ensure the highest quality document is always delivered.
  • Maintains a high level of flexibility. Proactively creates and resets priorities as the need arises to adhere to standard turnaround times. Identifies and raises issues before they become critical and adjusts quickly to the changes of a dynamic organization.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned. Minimal travel may be required (up to 25%).

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

  • BA/BS degree in a Business Administration, Finance or Legal field with a minimum of 3 to 6 years of experience preferably in contract drafting, and/or contracts management within a pharmaceutical research, go to market, and/or healthcare environment; or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • Must be customer-centric, self-motivated, and proactive.
  • Flexibility in responding to job demands.
  • Must have excellent problem-solving skills and above average attention to detail.
  • Ability to perform several tasks simultaneously to meet critical deadlines and possess strong analytical skills.
  • Ability to work successfully in a team environment and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and manager.
  • Demonstrates effective time management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks with management guidance and oversight.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrates a positive and flexible attitude toward new and/or unconventional work assignments.
  • Ability to consistently perform and deliver a high-quality work product.
  • Excellent organizational skills with ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Professional ability to interact with individuals at all levels and different personalities.
  • Good interpersonal skills and ability to work well with others.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

Director, Technical Readiness

College Board - Operations

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

College Board's Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance user experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement (AP) examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. ADO’s User Readiness team ensures every district-level member, school-level educator, and test taker has what they need, and takes the critical actions required, to succeed on test day. This is done through multi-channel community engagement, effective digital communications, curated technical guidance, and risk-based outreach.

About the Opportunity

As the Director, Technical Readiness, you will make sure every testing environment is technically ready for digital testing, from the networks and devices students test on to the platform changes coordinators need to know about. You will serve as the assessment delivery requirements owner and primary liaison to the Bluebook team, translating technical and platform requirements into clear guidance that coordinators, school technology staff, and internal teams can act on across all College Board assessment programs. You will help support network engineer resources dedicated to this work, working closely with product, technology, and test day delivery teams to set readiness standards, spot technical risk early, and help prevent issues before they reach students on test day.

In this role, you will:

Technical and Platform Readiness Requirements (40%)

  • Own the translation of technical and platform changes into clear requirements and guidance for each audience. Audiences include test administration coordinators, technology monitors, school technology staff, and internal technical support teams
  • Maintain current technical readiness requirements for Bluebook, College Board’s digital testing application, and coordinator tools
  • Partner with product and technology teams early in the release cycle to identify the operational and user impact of upcoming changes
  • Contribute to operational readiness for new platform pilots by documenting technical requirements and readiness procedures
  • Develop the technical content for readiness communications and resources, partnering with the Digital Engagement team on channel and delivery

Network and Device Readiness (35%)

  • Help support network engineer resources dedicated to large and commercial venue network risk analysis, providing technical direction and staying hands-on with complex readiness issues
  • Define network and device readiness standards for school-owned testing devices and College Board loaner devices
  • Design readiness checks, diagnostic guidance, and troubleshooting resources for coordinators, support teams, and field staff to use in resolving issues
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex network and device readiness issues, partnering with technology teams and vendors to resolve them
  • Analyze technical incident trends to find root causes, and recommend changes that reduce preventable testing incidents
  • Coordinate with supply chain partners on loaner device requirements and readiness

Cross-Functional Partnership (25%)

  • Partner closely with the test day delivery team to align technical guidance, share release impacts, and support technical escalations during testing windows
  • Equip community engagement and proactive outreach partners with the technical knowledge coordinators need
  • Track and manage readiness work and requests in Jira and Salesforce
  • Document durable processes and guidance so technical knowledge is shared across teams rather than held by individuals

About You

  • Expertise in technical readiness, IT operations, or technical program work, with 5-7 years of experience translating technical requirements for non-technical audiences
  • Deep, currently knowledge of network environments, such as bandwidth, firewalls, content filtering, and allowlisting, and of managed device fleets across common operating systems, with the credibility to work closely with and support network and system engineers
  • Experience managing technical change: assessing the impact of software releases or platform updates and preparing users for them
  • Strong technical writing skills, including turning complex technical information into clear, step-by-step guidance
  • Experience analyzing incident or support data to identify root causes and recommend preventive fixes
  • Experience partnering with product, engineering, and vendor teams on requirements and escalations
  • Proficiency with Jira and Salesforce
  • Preferred: Experience in K-12, higher education, or enterprise IT environments. Technical certifications such as CompTIA Network+ are welcome but not required
  • A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, a performance exercise relevant to the role, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000–$140,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Job Description:


Responsible for carrying out case management activities for PPO members identified through data or by Health Plan and referred to HPMG. Case management is a collaborative process that assesses, plans, implements, coordinates, monitors, and evaluates options and services required to meet the client’s health and human service needs. It is characterized by advocacy, communication and resource management and promotes quality and cost-effective interventions and outcomes. Case management activities are based on nationally recognized case management standards and concepts and principles. All contacts are telephonic.


Job Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Health Plans care and disease management programs to maximize the at-risk population member’s quality and manage their costs.
  • Assess members’ physical and psychosocial needs/barriers and develop a care plan.
  • Support and encourage the use of participating Health Plan providers.
  • Develop and implement the interventions needed to resolve barriers and coordinate care, allowing members to accomplish their goals with physician guidance and supervision.
  • Document in Epic; assessments, care plans, interventions, and all other activity related to coordinating the care of case-managed members.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintain client privacy, safety, confidentiality, and advocacy while adhering to ethical, legal, regulatory and accreditation standards.
  • Maintain department procedure/policy standards with regard to turnaround time, etc.
  • Support the interdisciplinary team approach to ensure effective resource utilization, as well as quality and cost-effective outcomes.
  • Coordinate internal and external resources for the individual member.
  • Maintain and update a community resource database.
  • Document all case management activities in the HPMG case management online system.
  • Issue letters of explanation in accordance with department policy.
  • Attend and participate in in-service programs and conferences that support practice of case management.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Experience

  • Minimum three years clinical nursing experience in an area such as medical/surgical, critical care, home health or skilled nursing, and;
  • Two years of experience in case management, behavioral health, utilization management, discharge planning, and or quality improvement in a managed care setting.
  • Experience with managed care delivery including IPA networks and Medicare. PPO experience preferred.
  • Optimum organizational skills with ability to meet both expected and unexpected time frames.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with a variety of customers including members, providers, office staff, health plans, internal department, community resources, and peers.
  • Ability to work independently with self-initiative and discipline.
  • Knowledge of ICD-9 and or CPT coding.
  • Working knowledge of personal computers.

Required Education

  • A.S. degree
  • Unrestricted California Registered Nurse licensure; certification in case management preferred.

Additional Information

Salary: $100,100 - $123,000 Annual


Hill Physicians is an Equal Opportunity Employer

This role identifies and accelerates business opportunities, removes barriers to execution, strengthens field execution and key account management, and drives adoption of strategic initiatives that enhance customer impact and business performance.

About Proximity Foundation

Proximity Foundation runs structured coding education programs for young people aged 14-18 at Community Care Institutions (CCIs). Using a computer-based LMS curriculum covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL, we pair students with volunteer mentors in cohort-based sessions designed to build real technical skills and lasting confidence.

We are scaling from the first cohort to many cohorts within Mumbai and building the operational team that will carry this program forward. Every role in Proximity Foundation is a direct investment in the young people we serve.

Role Type : Volunteer

Time Commitment : 2-3 hrs. a week

Department : Communication & Outreach

Reports to : Communication & Outreach Lead

ROLE FOCUS

Supporting the content engine of Proximity Foundation. Create compelling, on-brand digital content — social media posts, impact stories, graphics, and program updates — that serves both the Communications & Outreach team's recruitment and visibility goals and the Partnership & Engagement team's donor and partner engagement needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Content Creation for Comms & Outreach
    • Produce social media content (LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X) aligned with the communication calendar
    • Write impact stories and program updates showcasing student journeys and volunteer contributions
    • Create or source graphics, visuals, and templates aligned to Proximity Foundation's brand identity
    • Draft volunteer recruitment posts and outreach materials as directed by the Comm & Outreach Lead
  • Content Creation for Partnerships & Engagement
    • Produce content for donor briefings, partner introductions, and pitch materials — briefed by the Comm & Outreach Lead in coordination with the Partnership & Engagement Lead
    • Create one-pagers, impact summaries, or presentation assets as directed for specific donor or partner engagements
    • Ensure all partnership/donor-facing content is accurate, compelling, and approved before use
  • Process & Workflow
    • Submit all content drafts to the Communication & Outreach Lead for review before any publishing or sharing
    • Incorporate feedback promptly — do not publish or share independently
    • Maintain a shared, organised content library accessible to both the Comms and Partnerships teams
    • Follow the agreed content calendar and deliver to agreed deadlines
  • Reporting
    • Provide a weekly update to the Comm & Outreach Lead on content produced, pending approvals, and upcoming planned content

WHAT A TYPICAL WEEK LOOKS LIKE

You'll be creating and scheduling content, collaborating with the Partnerships Lead on what materials they need next, reviewing work from the other Content Creators of your team.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

You'll build Proximity Foundation's voice from the ground up — and the materials you create will directly open doors to partnerships and funding that sustain the program.

HOW TO APPLY

To express interest in this role, please send a short note (no formal CV required) to:

Tell us a little about yourself, why this role appeals to you, and any relevant experience. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds — enthusiasm and reliability matter most.

Requirements

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Content writing | LinkedIn / Instagram | Figma/Canva / presentation design | Stakeholder communication | Content strategy | Brand Guidelines

Only those candidates can apply who are:

    1. Can volunteer for 2-3 hrs a week without any pay/salary/stipend.

    3. Driven by the social initiatives and want to make an impact in the lives of under-privileged students.

BENEFITS

  • Certificate
  • Letter of recommendation
  • Flexible work hours
