Become a part of our caring community

The Corporate Medical Director relies on medical background and reviews of medical records for appeals decisions. The Corporate Medical Director works on problems of diverse scope and complexity ranging from moderate to substantial.

The Corporate Medical Director provides clinical interpretation and makes determinations regarding the appropriateness of services delivered by other healthcare professionals, in accordance with established review policies, procedures, and performance standards. The Corporate Medical Director exercises independent judgment in addressing complex issues related to job responsibilities and associated tasks, applying critical analysis to variable factors and determining the most appropriate course of action.


  • Provide medical interpretation and clinical judgment regarding the appropriateness, necessity, and quality of services rendered by other healthcare professionals.
  • Perform or oversee clinical reviews of grievance and appeal cases for assigned markets, member populations, or condition-specific areas.
  • Ensure all determinations are made in compliance with medical review policies, regulatory requirements, internal procedures, and performance standards.
  • Serve as a clinical subject matter expert for complex grievance and appeal matters involving Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial products.
  • Make independent decisions on highly complex clinical issues, including cases with variable factors, incomplete information, or competing clinical considerations.
  • Act as a clinical resource for issues involving home health, rehabilitation, inpatient, outpatient, and transitional care services.
  • Ensure appeal and grievance reviews reflect knowledge of managed care operations, including Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial line-of-business requirements.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve consistency, turnaround times, compliance, and member-centered decision-making.
  • Contribute to initiatives focused on improving the member experience and reducing preventable escalations or dissatisfaction.
  • Provide expertise across relevant clinical specialties such as Internal Medicine, Family Practice, Geriatrics, and Hospital Medicine.
  • Support holidays and weekends as required based on business needs. After-hours coverage as required to maintain regulatory and operational review timelines.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging regulations, accreditation standards, and medical policy changes affecting grievance and appeal determinations.

  • Current, unrestricted licensure in at least one jurisdiction, with the ability and willingness to obtain additional unrestricted licenses, as needed, for states within the assigned region.

  • Prompt professional communication skills written and verbally

In this hands-on role, you'll help strengthen service reliability, improve operational workflows, and maintain the configurations that support incident management, service requests, and change coordination.

You'll collaborate with engineering and service-management teams, solve practical platform challenges, and apply your ServiceNow expertise in an environment where dependable technology directly supports an important federal healthcare mission.

What You'll Do

  • Configure and maintain ServiceNow ITSM capabilities supporting incident management, service requests, and daily service operations.
  • Maintain incident and request routing, assignment rules, and service-level agreement (SLA) definitions, including appropriate pause handling and service-level tracking.
  • Build and maintain service catalog items, provisioning workflows, and related operational dependency documentation.
  • Implement approved platform changes, coordinate technical handoffs with release-management stakeholders, and maintain supporting records and documentation.
  • Investigate configuration issues, troubleshoot workflow behavior, and collaborate with technical teams to improve platform reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Support occasional site go-lives and exercises, including onsite assistance with designated ServiceNow field-service or mobile configurations when needed.
  • Prepare monthly SLA evidence extracts and supporting technical records for operational reporting and assurance reviews.

Required Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM) administration experience, including configuration and maintenance of operational service-management capabilities.
  • Eligibility for a Tier 3 federal background investigation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for site go-lives and exercise support.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist — IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM) certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Field Service Management.
  • Administering ServiceNow ITSM in complex enterprise environments.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, we value technical ownership, thoughtful problem-solving, and collaboration. You'll have the opportunity to strengthen your ServiceNow expertise, contribute to meaningful improvements in enterprise IT service management, and work alongside professionals focused on delivering dependable technology solutions.

Benefits & Perks

Rackner offers a comprehensive benefits program designed to support professional growth and overall well-being, including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
  • 401(k) with a 100% company match up to 6%.

  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support.

Work Arrangement

This position is remote within the United States, with occasional travel required to support designated site go-lives and exercises.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
About Sendmarc

We are a cyber security company that is on a mission to make the internet a safer place. We do this by delivering tooling and services related to an international standard, DMARC. Our technology enables organisations to protect their staff, customers, suppliers, and the whole world from email spoofing and impersonation attacks on their domains.

We’re a fully remote company with the majority of our builders working out of South Africa and sales teams in the Netherlands, the US, Latin America, Australia and the UK.

Mission

Own and scale Sendmarc’s vendor alliances across the US, turning strong partner relationships into a growing, predictable source of pipeline and revenue.

Why This Role Exists

Alliances multiply what a sales team can do alone. Our vendor partners’ field teams meet organisations with DMARC gaps every day, and vendor alliances are already one of our strongest go-to-market motions in the Americas. The upside is in how far they spread.

You’ll take that motion from the partner reps already engaged to broad regional participation, with the enablement, relationships and events that make Sendmarc the obvious answer when a partner rep spots an opportunity. You’ll work closely with our Director of Channel and Alliances, the North America sales team and Marketing, and have real say in how our alliance programme grows.

Outcomes

The four core outcomes this role is accountable for:

  1. Scale Vendor Alliances

Grow alliance-attributed pipeline and revenue across the region. Widen engagement from a small group of AEs and Sales Managers to broad participation, through joint account mapping, deal registration and targeted outreach to accounts with DMARC gaps.

  1. Enablement

Build the training, battlecards and joint messaging that let partner reps identify and qualify DMARC opportunities on their own.

  1. Regional Presence

Build lasting relationships with partner Sales Managers, channel reps, SDRs and marketing counterparts, so Sendmarc is a known participant in their regional sales cadence and event calendar.

  1. Events and Content

Represent Sendmarc at partner events, from Black Hat and RSA to regional events, and keep a regular content cadence going with Marketing.

Who We’re Looking For

You’re a relationship builder who gets energy from helping another company’s reps win. You know an alliance works when the partner’s team wants you in the room.

You bring the discipline to track what the relationship produces, and the instincts to know when a call will land better than an email. Cyber security experience helps. A record of growing a co-sell motion with a named technology partner matters more, and we’d like to see the numbers.

Competencies

ALLIANCE MANAGEMENT

  • Track record of building or scaling a co-sell motion with a named technology partner
  • Comfortable with deal registration, joint account mapping and segmented outreach
  • Owns a number, and reports pipeline and revenue against quarterly targets

WAYS OF WORKING

  • Works fluently with sales, marketing and the partner’s own team to keep the relationship enabled and engaged
  • Builds relationships with sales managers, AEs, SDRs and channel reps at the partner
  • Happy to travel for events and quarterly business reviews

ENABLEMENT AND CONTENT

  • Builds training, battlecards and joint messaging that reps use without help
  • Digital marketing or content experience (video, social) is a plus

EXPERIENCE

  • 3 to 6+ years in channel, alliance or partner management, ideally in cyber security or B2B SaaS
  • Familiarity with the email security and DMARC landscape (Proofpoint, Mimecast, Valimail) is a strong plus

Relationships

Reports to: Director of Channel and Alliances (US)

Team: Channel and Alliances (US)

Key Collaborators: The Director of Channel and Alliances on partner strategy; the North America sales team on co-sell pipeline; Vendor partners’ sales managers, channel reps and marketing counterparts; Sendmarc’s Marketing team on content and events

Primary Tools: HubSpot, Slack

From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.

What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.

For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.

Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.

Requirements

The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:

As an BI Developer reporting to Analytics Engineering Lead, your purpose will be to help us build our data foundations from scratch:

  • Build semantic layers in Looker that colleagues can navigate without guidance
  • Create dashboards on Booksy data that are clear and easy to use
  • Learn Booksy's KPIs and data well enough to work independently
  • Review smaller pieces of work from fellow analytics engineers


Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…

1. Hands-on Looker and LookML experience

2. Strong SQL, ideally in BigQuery, including a sound grasp of joins and query cost

3. Experience turning raw data into clear, user-friendly dashboards

4. The ability to explain technical work to non-technical colleagues

5. At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.

## It will also help you to have…

1. Python, for example for scripting around Looker

2. Familiarity with dbt

3. Curiosity about AI tools, plus the habit of checking their output

Benefits

Some of the benefits we offer are:

  • We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first.
  • Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
  • Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.

Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:

We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at , so we can best support you.

The Senior Process Improvement Professional will provide business ownership and leadership for strategic Medicaid enrollment and waiver modernization initiatives that support operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and accurate member administration. These roles will partner across Enrollment, Clinical, Claims, Finance, and Technology teams to design, implement, and sustain enterprise solutions that reduce manual effort, improve data integrity, and mitigate operational risk.


The positions will be dedicated to advancing member movement capabilities and waiver administration enhancements that have significant downstream impacts across the organization.

Lead Enterprise Member Movement Enhancements

  • Serve as a business lead for initiatives that improve the organization's ability to execute large-scale member movement activities accurately and efficiently.
  • Partner with Information Technology and business stakeholders to define requirements, conduct testing, validate results, and support implementation activities.

Lead Medicaid Waiver Modernization Efforts

  • Support training, change management, and adoption efforts for new processes and capabilities.

Continuous Improvement and Governance

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational performance.
  • Establish monitoring, reporting, and governance practices to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend enhancements that improve efficiency, scalability, and member experience.
  • Support enterprise transformation initiatives focused on Medicaid operations and enrollment modernization.

Number of Openings: 2 Senior Process Improvement Professionals. These positions will provide dedicated support for Medicaid member mass movement enhancements and multiple waiver administration initiatives while ensuring effective governance of LTSS waiver operations and related business processes.


Use your skills to make an impact

At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Say hello to a rewarding career, and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

The Sales Operations Analyst supports the GTM, with ownership of ACV performance (Pipeline and Bookings) and Revenue performance (post‑booking).

This role partners closely with General Managers, their leadership teams, and their GTM stakeholders to drive visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and revenue realization, ensuring disciplined execution across the commercial lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

Own annual planning for pipeline modeling and Booked ACV targets, including ongoing performance analysis across Pipeline ACV, Booked ACV, and Revenue

Monitor adherence to pipeline and forecast standards, identifying risks, gaps, and performance trends

Monitor and report on core performance KPIs including: Sales Cycle, ASP (Average Selling Price), Win Rates

Analyze pipeline health including coverage, velocity, aging, conversion, and slippage

Support weekly pipeline and operating reviews, providing data and performance insight

Partner with GMs on rep and team performance, identifying execution gaps and improvement opportunities

Provide insight into how pipeline and bookings quality impact downstream revenue realization

Collaborate with Finance and Marketing Operations to support alignment across pipeline, bookings, and revenue.

Provide performance analysis and business insight to support segmentation and planning decisions

Partner with Revenue Technology and Sales Operations to support reporting and analytics requirements related to CRM enhancements

Continuously improve reporting, dashboards, and analysis that support GM decision-making

Explore and adopt ways AI and advanced analytics can improve forecasting, performance insight, and execution rigor


About You

You are a business‑minded analytics partner who understands the connection between pipeline execution, ACV bookings, and realized revenue through usage. You are comfortable working directly with GMs, Sales, and Customer Success leaders, and you use data to drive clarity and action.


You bring:

Strong understanding of ACV‑based sales models and usage‑based revenue

Ability to translate data into clear, practical insights

Comfort operating in a GM‑led Sales + Customer Success environment

Hands-on experience using AI to improve performance analytics, reporting, or forecasting workflows

You know how to spot operational friction and turn it into clearer process, better reporting, and stronger execution.

A bias toward clarity, rigor, and accountability


Experience & Qualifications

7+ Years of experience in Revenue Performance, Sales Analytics, or Revenue Operations

Strong working knowledge of Revenue Tech Stack (e.g., Salesforce, Gong Forecasting, , ZoomInfo).

Experience with BI platforms (e.g., Power BI)

raw.description:
• At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

The Homeland Sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Data Engineer with a strong background in data analytics to support an exciting DHS software development program. The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining the data architecture, pipelines, integrations, and data structures required to transform raw operational data into reliable, accessible, and analysis-ready information. The Data Engineer works across application, database, analytics, and business teams to ensure that data is accurately collected, integrated, transformed, governed, secured, and made available for reporting, business intelligence (BI), advanced analytics, and decision support.

Expected Duties and Responsibilities

Data Architecture and Engineering

  • Design logical and physical data models appropriate for analytical workloads.
  • Develop data structures that integrate information from multiple applications, databases, files, APIs, logs, and external data sources.
  • Evaluate existing data architectures and recommend improvements to reliability, scalability, performance, maintainability, and accessibility.
  • Support the design and implementation of data warehouses, data marts, data lakes, lakehouses, and other analytical data repositories as appropriate.

Data Integration and Pipelines

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain ETL/ELT processes and automated data pipelines.
  • Extract and integrate data from relational databases, applications, APIs, flat files, logs, and other structured and semi-structured sources.
  • Develop repeatable processes for transforming raw transactional data into standardized, analysis-ready datasets.
  • Implement scheduling, orchestration, monitoring, error handling, and recovery capabilities for data pipelines.
  • Develop interfaces and data feeds supporting downstream reporting, dashboards, analytics platforms, and external systems.

Data Transformation and Quality

  • Clean, normalize, deduplicate, validate, and transform data.
  • Investigate data discrepancies and work with application developers, database administrators, analysts, and business users to determine root causes.
  • Implement controls that prevent data-quality problems from propagating into downstream reports and analytical products.

Business Intelligence and Analytics Support

  • Develop curated datasets and data models optimized for BI, reporting, visualization, and analytical workloads.
  • Work with BI analysts and business stakeholders to translate business questions into data requirements.
  • Support development of common definitions and calculation methodologies for enterprise metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Support ad hoc analytical requests when new data sources or transformations are required.
  • Assist analysts in understanding data lineage, relationships, limitations, and appropriate use.

Data Governance and Documentation

  • Document data sources, transformations, interfaces, business rules, dependencies, lineage, and data definitions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, models, interfaces, and analytical repositories.
  • Support development and maintenance of data dictionaries and metadata repositories.

Database and Performance Engineering

  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data transformations.
  • Analyze and improve performance of analytical queries and data-processing workloads.
  • Work with Database Administrators (DBAs) to optimize database structures supporting analytical requirements.
  • Recommend indexing, partitioning, aggregation, caching, or other techniques where appropriate.
  • Ensure analytical workloads do not adversely affect production transactional systems.

Security and Compliance

  • Implement data-engineering solutions consistent with organizational cybersecurity and privacy requirements.
  • Apply appropriate access controls to sensitive data.
  • Support data classification, encryption, auditing, logging, retention, and protection requirements.
  • Work with cybersecurity personnel to ensure data movement and storage comply with applicable security requirements.
  • Support protection of sensitive information, including PII and other controlled or restricted data.

Software Engineering and DevSecOps

  • Develop maintainable data-engineering code using established software development practices.
  • Maintain data pipeline code and configuration under version control.
  • Participate in peer reviews, testing, configuration management, and change-control processes.
  • Develop automated tests for data transformations and pipelines.
  • Support CI/CD and automated deployment practices for data-engineering components.
  • Troubleshoot production data-processing failures and perform root-cause analysis.

Basic Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • Must be capable of receiving a Public Trust clearance level.
  • Must have verifiable accredited education.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline.

Experience Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, database development, software engineering, BI engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and developing ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.
  • Strong experience with relational databases and SQL.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple heterogeneous sources.
  • Experience developing analytical data models, data warehouses, or similar repositories.
  • Experience troubleshooting data-quality and data-integration issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with technologies such as Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

Required Technical Skills

The candidate should possess strong proficiency in several of the following areas:

  • Advanced SQL and relational database concepts
  • Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or comparable RDBMS technologies
  • Python or another data-processing/programming language
  • ETL/ELT development
  • Data modeling and dimensional modeling
  • Data warehouse architecture
  • REST APIs and system integration
  • Data validation and quality management
  • Git or comparable version-control systems
  • Automated testing and CI/CD concepts
  • Structured and semi-structured data processing

Knowledge and Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to understand complex relationships among applications, databases, interfaces, and business processes.
  • Ability to translate business information requirements into technical data solutions.
  • Understanding of transactional versus analytical data architectures.
  • Understanding of data lineage, governance, quality, security, and lifecycle management.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to distinguish between a data problem, application problem, business-process problem, and analytical problem.
  • Strong documentation and configuration-management discipline.

Job Description

Agilent Korea. The statutory and operational responsibilities associated with the Korea Quality Manager role will be the primary responsibility of this position. Additional regional responsibilities may also be performed to provide oversight, processes, and tools to the operating companies and channel partners (importers, distributors, sellers/resellers, dealers, service providers, sales & marketing agents) who execute commercial quality activities for Agilent in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region.

This role involves working with cross-functional teams to execute, improve, maintain and monitor these regional quality activities. The Manager will report directly to the International Quality Lead. The candidate must meet the applicable statutory qualification requirements to serve as the registered Quality Manager for IVD medical devices in South Korea.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Overview

The Manager, Regional Quality Assurance (QA) will serve as the registered IVD Medical Device Quality Manager(품질책임자) for Agilent Korea. The statutory and operational responsibilities associated with the Korea Quality Manager(품질책임자) role will be the primary responsibility of this position. Additional regional responsibilities may also be performed to provide oversight, processes, and tools to the operating companies and channel partners (importers, distributors, sellers/resellers, dealers, service providers, sales & marketing agents) who execute commercial quality activities for Agilent in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region.

This role involves working with cross-functional teams to execute, improve, maintain and monitor these regional quality activities. The Manager will report directly to the International Quality. The candidate must meet the applicable statutory qualification requirements to serve as the registered Quality Manager(품질책임자) for IVD medical devices in South Korea.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Main Responsibilities (as South Korea Registered Medical Device and IVD Quality Manager(품질책임자))

  • Manage and strengthen governance and quality systems of Agilent Korea IVD Import License Model against the MFDS regulations. Current model: warehouse (storage) and testing (inspection/lab) activities are outsourced.
  • Responsible for key commercial quality activities: outsourced warehouse oversight, contractual agreement, testing review, product quality inspection, product release approval, inspection/audit readiness, deviation/CAPA management, and post market activities.
  • Maintain Korea QMS documentation and records: procedures, document change records, communication records, facility maintenance records, equipment maintenance/calibration/repair records, customer complaints, deviations, corrective/preventive actions, training records, test and inspection records, and product release records.
  • Perform and/or host audits and inspections, including MFDS Audits for various licenses, Warehouse Audits, and KGMP Audit on registered Agilent manufacturing sites.
  • Provide training to relevant Korea personnel on Commercial Quality requirements, procedures and responsibilities.
  • Receive the mandatory 8-hour training annually per MFDS requirement.
  • Prepare Medical Devices reports, including Import Annual Reports(의료기기 실적보고) and Pre-Import Reports (표준통관예정보고).

Additional Regional Responsibilities

  • Establish QMS processes and tools systems to ensure consistent execution of commercial quality activities across APAC region.
  • Negotiate quality agreements and/or the quality elements of contracts with the APAC operating companies and channel partners to ensure accountability.
  • Direct customer-reported quality signals and feedback related to commercial activities to the International Quality to coordinate the correct QMS processes for issue management and escalation.
  • Support regional audits/inspections, and internal reviews related to commercial quality processes.
  • Partner with regulatory and regional teams to identify quality activities performed by other functions and establish communication channels and community of practice.
  • Enable consistent quality execution across markets and commercial organizations in APAC through processes and training programs.
  • Assist in a risk-based approach for oversight of compliance and the health of the commercial quality processes.
  • Track APAC regional commercial quality issues, trends, and risks.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor of Science (BS or BSc) degree in Engineering, Science, Life Science, Medical, Clinical Laboratory Science, or another relevant technical discipline is required, or directly equivalent experience in Quality Assurance. The candidate must meet the applicable statutory qualification requirements to serve as the registered Quality Manager (품질책임자) for IVD medical devices in South Korea. Eligibility must be verified before appointment.
  • Advanced degrees, including an MBA or a relevant professional certification in Quality Management, Engineering, Life Sciences, Medical Devices, or Regulatory Affairs are preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial Quality, including substantial hands-on experience in medical device or IVD Quality Assurance and import quality operations.
  • Prior experience serving as, or directly supporting, a registered Quality Manager (품질책임자) for a medical device or IVD manufacturer or importer in South Korea is strongly preferred.
  • Experienced in Regulated Product Environments, such as Medical Devices, In-Vitro Diagnostic Devices (IVDs), BioPharma, or other related Life Science industry, with medical device or IVD experience strongly preferred.
  • Experienced in conducting and/hosting audits and inspections, with strong knowledge of applicable Korean medical device and IVD requirements, KGMP, and relevant international standards and regulations, including US FDA CFRs, EU IVDR, MDSAP requirements, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO 9001, and the application to establish a strong QMS.

Essential Skills

  • Professional proficiency in Korean and English, including the ability to read, interpret, and prepare regulatory and quality documentation.
  • Strong understanding of both International and APAC country-specific compliance considerations, including and not limited to South Korea, Japan, Australia/New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand.
  • Experience working cross functionally with Marketing, Sales, Commercial Compliance, Legal Compliance, Field Service, Regulatory, and Quality teams.
  • Proven ability to manage risks and ensure consistency across regional organizations. Escalate issues promptly and concisely into the International Quality Lead.
  • Proven ability to take independent actions to initiate process improvement. Align actions accordingly with the International Quality.
  • Ability to engage, influence, and negotiate with stakeholders, including business group leaders and peers, in a matrixed environment.
  • Able to lead and manage the execution of processes, projects and programs within the APAC region.
  • Well-organized, able to multitask and prioritize competing tasks.
  • Advanced MS Office skills (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Basic AI knowledge to facilitate efficiencies in day-to-day responsibilities (e.g. custom reports/dashboards, visualizations in analytical tools, metrics and data presentation).

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

The Environmental Program Leader – Hazardous Waste and Dangerous Goods Compliance will provide enterprise leadership, technical expertise, and continuous improvement across hazardous waste management and dangerous goods/hazmat transportation. In this highly visible role, the successful candidate will shape strategy, influence enterprise standards, and partner across sites and functions to strengthen compliance, standardize processes, improve environmental performance, and enable safe, reliable operations across the business.

This role is ideal for a senior environmental leader who brings deep technical expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to drive impact across a complex, matrixed organization – translating complex regulatory requirements into clear, practical, and scalable processes that support both compliance excellence and operational execution.

Success in this role requires a demonstrated ability to work across functional teams to achieve environmental and compliance objectives; strong problem-solving, project management, planning, organizational, time management, and analytical skills; and strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical environmental risks and requirements for non-technical audiences and influence positive behavioral change.

This position will require up to 30% travel.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead enterprise direction for hazardous waste and dangerous goods compliance, including development and execution of short- and long-term goals and objectives for the EHS function.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise standard work for waste characterization, container management, labeling, storage, inspection, manifesting, and vendor qualification.
  • Provide technical environmental support, practical guidance, and compliance solutions to GE Aerospace sites on hazardous waste and dangerous goods requirements.
  • Monitor environmental programs for compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, and recommend business-level environmental policies, programs, and improvement initiatives.
  • Represent GE Aerospace with governmental environmental agencies and trade/professional associations to support regulatory interpretation and compliance alignment.
  • Track environmental performance metrics and drive actions that improve compliance and operating performance.
  • Prepare comments on proposed environmental regulations and assess potential business impacts.
  • Support sites with waste determinations, supporting documentation, analytical methods, and compliance execution.
  • Participate in internal and external compliance audits and support audit readiness, inspection response, CAPA development, and closure verification for recurring or material findings.
  • Provide governance for dangerous goods/hazmat transportation, including classification, packaging, marking, labeling, shipping papers, modal requirements, training controls, and shipment readiness reviews.
  • Review trends from incidents, near misses, shipment errors, permit events, and vendor performance to identify risks and prioritize preventive actions.
  • Lead practical training and coaching for site EHS operations, with a focus on common failure modes and effective controls.
  • Partner with site EHS, legal, operations, quality, and logistics teams to interpret requirements and implement practical controls aligned to site processes.
  • Estimated travel required is about 30%

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Minimum of 5 years of industry experience in environmental compliance, hazardous waste, dangerous goods, or related EHS disciplines.
  • Knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to environmental operations in the geographic regions where GE Aerospace operates.
  • Experience working with complex dangerous goods and hazardous waste regulations.

Desired Characteristics and Experience:

  • 15+ years of industry experience
  • Bachelor's degree in environmental or engineering, an advanced technical degree, and/or Professional Engineer (PE) license
  • Experience with Hazardous Secondary Materials
  • Enterprise mindset with the ability to connect regulatory requirements to practical business execution
  • Ability to simplify complex technical topics into clear expectations and actions
  • Passion for building capability, strengthening standard work, and driving sustainable results.
  • Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn
  • Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively
  • Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed
  • Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative
  • Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker

The base pay range for this position is $157,000 - $210,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 13, 2026.


GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness. ​


GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.


This role will require in-person attendance for New Hire Orientation on Day 1.

Additional Information

GE Aerospace offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Aerospace will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). Employees may also be subject to random and reasonable-suspicion drug and alcohol testing.


Relocation Assistance Provided: No

- This is a remote position

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Director, Strategic Alliances & Marketplaces, will lead a team of professionals that will turn Lumen’s strategic technology partnerships and digital marketplaces into measurable business outcomes.

This executive leader will own key hyperscaler and technology relationships while bringing commercial discipline, strategic focus, and operational rigor to the partner ecosystem.

Success requires deep expertise in partner commercial programs, marketplace economics, incentives, contractual structures, and co-sell motions. This leader will connect strategy to execution, mobilizing teams across the organization to convert ecosystem opportunities into pipeline, revenue, customer acquisition, and solution adoption.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Translate partner programs, incentives, funding mechanisms, commercial terms, and marketplace economics into actionable growth opportunities for Lumen.
  • Lead, Manage and Develop a Team of Professionals
  • Identify and activate opportunities to increase partner-led pipeline, bookings, customer acquisition, solution adoption, and seller engagement.
  • Lead marketplace strategy and execution, including listings, private offers, joint offers, transactable solutions, and partner consumption programs.
  • Partner with Sales and Product to develop scalable co-sell, marketplace, and ecosystem-led commercial motions.
  • Build business cases and commercial models that assess strategic opportunities, required investments, economics, and expected returns.
  • Establish visibility and accountability for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, marketplace performance, program utilization, and commercial outcomes.
  • Influence across Sales, Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Operations, and partner organizations to remove barriers and accelerate execution.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Twelve plus years of experience in strategic alliances, business development, cloud marketplaces, partner strategy, or related commercial roles.
  • Demonstrated experience working within major technology ecosystems such as Microsoft, AWS, Google, Palo Alto Networks or comparable strategic technology partners.
  • Deep knowledge of partner commercial programs, incentives, funding mechanisms, co-sell structures, marketplace economics, contractual structures, and commercial terms.
  • Proven ability to translate ecosystem opportunities and partner programs into measurable pipeline, bookings, revenue, customer acquisition, solution adoption, or other commercial outcomes.
  • Experience developing and scaling marketplace, co-sell, or ecosystem-led sales motions, including joint business plans, private offers, joint offers, or transactable solutions.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience developing business cases and evaluating economics, investments, and expected returns.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex organizations, mobilize cross-functional teams, and communicate, influence, and negotiate effectively at the executive level.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with experience in cloud, cybersecurity, networking, telecommunications, or enterprise technology. Advanced business degree is a plus.

Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift:

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description:

The Business Systems Analyst – Salesforce Developer serves as a key technical and functional resource responsible for supporting, maintaining, and enhancing the Salesforce platform. This role combines traditional Business Systems Analysis responsibilities with hands-on Salesforce development and administration, with particular emphasis on Apex backend development, existing-code maintenance, troubleshooting, integrations, automation, and production stability.


The ideal candidate is comfortable taking ownership of an established Salesforce environment containing custom Apex, triggers, Lightning components, Flows, integrations, and complex business processes. The position partners closely with Sales Operations, business stakeholders, IT, and other technical teams to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions while protecting the stability and maintainability of the existing platform.


Key Responsibilities:


Salesforce Development & Backend Maintenance

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, refactor, and enhance existing Apex classes, triggers, test classes, batch processes, scheduled jobs, and asynchronous Apex.
  • Analyze legacy Salesforce code and automation to understand dependencies and safely implement enhancements.
  • Develop scalable Apex solutions following Salesforce development best practices.
  • Maintain appropriate Apex test coverage and ensure changes do not negatively affect existing functionality.
  • Troubleshoot production issues involving custom code, automation, integrations, data, security, and configuration.
  • Develop and maintain Lightning Web Components (LWC) where custom user experiences are required.
  • Write and optimize SOQL/SOSL queries supporting application functionality and troubleshooting.

Salesforce Administration & Configuration

  • Configure and maintain custom and standard objects, fields, relationships, page layouts, record types, validation rules, permissions, and other platform configuration.
  • Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Salesforce Flow and other platform automation.
  • Evaluate existing automation and identify opportunities to eliminate redundant or conflicting processing.

Integrations & Technical Support

  • Support and troubleshoot integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications.
  • Maintain Apex-based integrations, APIs, HTTP callouts, authentication/configuration dependencies, and associated error-handling processes.

Skills:

Salesforce (Software), Salesforce Administration, Salesforce Apex, Salesforce API, Salesforce Configuration, Salesforce Development, Salesforce DevOps, Salesforce Integration, Salesforce Platform, Salesforce System

Education & Experience:

Minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience | Required

Pay Range:

$128,600.00 - $168,735.00

Pay Range Explained:

This role in Livermore, California pays between $128,600.00 and $168,735.00 per year, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

FormFactor is an equal opportunity employer. FormFactor complies with all national, state, and local laws that seek to promote equal opportunities for any applicant or employee without regard to age, race, color, gender, gender identity/expression, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, disability, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, military service, or any other legally protected characteristics. Summary of Role

Solution Consultants are an integral part of Command Alkon's goal to deliver fully integrated technological solutions to the heavy building materials industry. Our mission is to help organizations harness the full potential of these solutions enabling them to improve inefficiencies, deliver visibility, automate, collaborate, and grow. Given the complexity of today’s business environment our customers need every advantage at their disposal to optimize performance. As a Solution Consultant, you will collaborate with cross functional teams to help our customers develop technological systems and solutions based off specific customer needs. Your goal is to complete customer implementations while providing a great customer experience.

How You’ll Succeed

  • Independently set up a customer environment with the CA dispatch products, including setting up SQL Server.
  • Deliver effective training in the CA products.
  • Effectively translate customer requirements into existing or new software functionality.
  • Continually strengthen and improve your customer service skills.
  • Work as a team to meet or exceed Command Alkon's Support SLA's.
  • Work with multiple internal teams to tailor the customer's journey to the business needs.
  • Collaborate with our customers to identify improvement in business operations and processes. - Uncover opportunities for additional product offerings to customers.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience of successfully implementing software with an intermediate knowledge of windows server environment.
  • Knowledge of MS SQL Server and MS SQL Reporting Services.
  • Demonstrated ability to determine the best way for an organization to move forward with its technology based on business analysis.
  • Curious mindset translating to key discovery skills (questioning & listening to understand) with the ability to identify problem areas (pain points).
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships with internal cross-functional teams and external customer teams in a variety of domestic and international offices across all levels of the organizations.
  • Ability to see, identify, and diagnose problems and find creative solutions. -Excellent organizational skills with the ability to self-organize priorities and balance your workload.

Who You Are

Business Insight - You apply knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals.

Manages Complexity - You make sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Drives Results - You consistently achieve results, even under tough circumstances.

Persuades - You use compelling arguments to gain the support and commitments of others.

Interpersonal Savvy - You relate openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.

Nimble Learning - You actively learn through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Ensures Accountability - You hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.

All Company Core Competencies

Customer Focus: You build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.

Cultivates Innovation: You create new and better ways for the organization to be successful.

Collaborates: You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Instills Trust: You gain the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.

Self-Development: You actively seek new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

About Furnished Finder:
Furnished Finder is the leading two-sided marketplace for monthly furnished rentals, connecting landlords with traveling professionals, remote workers, and relocating families seeking stays of 30 days or more. Trusted by over 7 million travelers each year, the platform offers a growing network of over 300,000 listings and more than 240,000 landlords nationwide — connecting renters to real homes in real communities, without booking fees or hidden costs. Newsweek named Furnished Finder one of America's Best Online Platforms in both 2025 and 2026, ranking it top 5 in the Real Estate category each year. Founded in 2014, the company continues to redefine flexible housing for the modern renter.

When you join Furnished Finder, you’re joining a leadership team with 70+ years of combined experience across real estate and travel. As we enter our next phase of growth, we’re looking for curious, motivated self-starters who are excited to learn, build, and grow alongside an industry-leading team. With roles based in Austin, TX (our HQ) and remote opportunities available, we’re growing quickly—and we’d love to meet you.

We’re looking for a high-energy Sales Representative to join our fast-paced team. In this role, you'll connect with 60-70 property owners daily through outbound calls and inbound leads, building relationships that transform landlords into successful partners on our platform. An ideal candidate thrives in a metrics-driven environment where speed, rapport, and value articulation are key.

Responsibilities:
  • Make 60–70 high-quality outbound calls per day to prospects and customers.
  • Responsible for maintaining responsiveness to incoming landlord inquiries and act as a trusted advisor.
  • Deliver a compelling pitch to promote Furnished Finder’s listing services.
  • Manage a high volume of leads with efficiency and urgency.
  • Document all activity in the CRM and track engagement success rates.
  • Convert qualified prospects into paying customers through short, consultative calls
  • Maintain accurate records in the CRM and follow up diligently.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual sales goals and team KPIs.
  • Promote premium features and upsell value-added services when applicable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and provide feedback.

Qualifications:
  • 1–2 years of sales experience (transactional or inside sales preferred).
  • Comfortable in a high-volume call environment.
  • Clear communicator with excellent phone presence and active listening skills.
  • Goal-oriented with a strong internal drive and sense of urgency.
  • Tech-savvy and able to navigate CRM systems and sales tools.
Education & Experience
  • High School Diploma or Associate’s Degree required.
  • 1+ year in sales, onboarding, or customer engagement roles.
  • Experience in real estate tech, SaaS, or platform-based sales is a plus.
  • Técnologo or profesional degree or equivalent professional experience preferred
Skills
  • English level required C1 (is a must)
  • Persuasive communication and negotiation
  • Customer engagement and conversion tracking
  • CRM proficiency and pipeline follow-up
  • Detail-oriented listing validation
What We Offer
  • Competitive base salary + performance-based commission
  • Flexible work environment (remote or hybrid, depending on location)
  • Ongoing sales training and development
  • Opportunities to grow within a fast-scaling company
  • Be part of a mission-driven business that helps professionals find housing

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Únete a nuestra misión de liderar el futuro de Snacking. Hazlo posible.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Accounting Specialist with 3+ years of experience to own the day-to-day books for our growing digital agency, from reconciliations and invoicing to payroll prep and month-end close.

You will work directly with our leadership team and outside CPA to keep QuickBooks Online accurate, get clients billed on time, and keep vendors and payroll running smoothly. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, curious, and responsive, and capable of solving routine issues independently while knowing when to escalate a decision. This is a full-time position.

Responsibilities

Reconciliations & Month-End Close

  • Reconcile every bank and credit card account in QuickBooks Online weekly and at month-end
  • Complete weekly reconciliations every Monday so QBO balances match actual bank statements
  • Catch and flag discrepancies such as missing deposits, duplicates, or wrong amounts the same day
  • Trace unusual transactions back to the bank, invoice, or contract before posting; journal entries require leadership approval
  • Deliver a monthly P&L, balance sheet, and AR aging by the 10th, with every account reconciled and nothing left in Uncategorized or Ask My Accountant
  • Keep the books clean and ready for our CPA's quarterly review

Invoicing & Accounts Receivable

  • Own monthly invoicing for all recurring clients through Nickel, sent on the 1st of every month
  • Issue one-time project invoices as new contracts are signed
  • Track open invoices and send payment reminders on anything 15+ days past due
  • Apply payments to the correct invoices
  • Ensure every contract is billed on time and continually reduce past-due AR

Accounts Payable & Payroll Prep

  • Enter vendor bills, schedule payments, and keep vendor records current
  • Pay vendors on time with zero late fees or penalties
  • Collect contractor hours, rate changes, and new-hire details for each biweekly payroll cycle
  • Submit and confirm payroll inputs before every ADP deadline

Documentation & Communication

  • Build and maintain written SOPs for every recurring process, including reconciliations, invoicing, payroll prep, and bills
  • Use QBO bank rules, templates, and available tools to resolve routine issues independently
  • Respond to client, vendor, and team questions within one business day
  • Escalate only the items that need a decision, with the research already done

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping for US small businesses
  • Daily, hands-on experience in QuickBooks Online, including bank feeds, bank rules, and reconciliations
  • Experience with invoicing, AR collections, and AP for a service business
  • Familiarity with US payroll inputs (W-2 and 1099 workers) and a provider like ADP or Gusto
  • Strong written English for client and vendor emails
  • Proven attention to detail and a habit of documenting your work

Preferred

  • Experience with Nickel or similar invoicing and payments platforms
  • Experience supporting a digital agency or professional services firm
  • Experience working alongside an outside CPA on quarterly reviews and year-end
  • QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification
  • Experience writing SOPs or process documentation

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6 months:

  • Every bank and card account is reconciled weekly, and QuickBooks matches the bank statements every week
  • Recurring client invoices go out on the 1st every month, and past-due AR is followed up consistently
  • Payroll inputs are submitted before every ADP cycle, and vendors are paid on time with zero late fees
  • A clean month-end package (P&L, balance sheet, AR aging) is delivered by the 10th every month, ready for our CPA's quarterly review
  • Every recurring process is documented in an SOP, so less leadership time is spent in the books

raw.description:
We're looking for a Long and Short Form Video Editor to watch YouTube content from a fast-growing social media creator, identify the best clippable moments, edit them into short-form clips, and run the creator's clipping pages across social platforms. This is a full-time, dedicated role for one creator's content operation.

You will spend most of your time watching videos, finding the moments that hit, clipping and editing them into shareable short-form content, and posting and managing the accounts where those clips live. You do not need to be a professional editor or have a marketing degree. You need good instincts for what makes a YouTube moment worth clipping, the ability to move fast, and the discipline to stay on top of a consistent posting schedule. AI tools for transcription and content review are encouraged. If you are plugged into creator culture, understand what performs on short-form platforms, and want a focused, high-output role inside a growing content operation, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work directly inside the content operation of a viral social media creator with a large and growing audience
  • High-output, focused role with real creative input into how the creator's content reaches new audiences

What You'll Work On

Content Clipping and Identification

  • Watch YouTube videos and long-form content to identify the best clippable moments including funny, surprising, emotional, controversial, or highly shareable sequences
  • Use AI transcription and review tools to move through content faster and surface moments efficiently
  • Develop a strong instinct for what works on short-form platforms and what will stop the scroll

Short-Form Video Editing

  • Edit identified moments into polished short-form clips ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X
  • Add captions, cuts, pacing adjustments, and light visual treatments to make clips platform-ready
  • Maintain a consistent output of clips without sacrificing quality

Social Page Management

  • Run and manage the creator's clipping pages across relevant platforms
  • Post consistently to a defined schedule and keep accounts active and growing
  • Monitor basic performance metrics and flag what is working to inform future clipping decisions
  • Engage with comments and community interactions on clipping pages as needed

What You Bring

  • Genuine understanding of what makes a YouTube or long-form video moment worth clipping; good instincts here matter more than a formal background
  • Comfortable watching and processing high volumes of video content efficiently, including using AI tools for transcription and review
  • Basic video editing skills with the ability to produce clean, platform-ready short-form clips
  • Active on social media and familiar with what performs on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X
  • Organized and consistent with the ability to maintain a regular posting schedule across multiple platforms
  • Fast and self-directed with minimal need for oversight on day-to-day clipping and posting decisions

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience clipping or repurposing long-form content for a creator, brand, or media account
  • Experience running and growing social media accounts or clipping pages independently
  • Familiarity with AI transcription and video review tools
  • Background in or passion for creator culture, entertainment, or viral content

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link or examples showing clips or short-form content you have created or pages you have managed
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience with content clipping or social media management, and explaining what you think makes a YouTube moment worth clipping

Only candidates who submit both examples and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you have good instincts for viral content, can move fast through long-form video to find the moments that matter, and want a focused full-time role inside a creator's content operation, this role gives you the volume and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

CoverMyMeds is recognized across McKesson as a leader in AI adoption. Our Technology organization runs on an AI-First operating model, with AI embedded in how we plan, build, secure, and deliver software. We are looking for a Senior Director, AI Enablement to lead the next stage of this transformation.


This Sr Director, AI Enablement will own AI strategy, governance, and AI engineering platforms for CoverMyMeds, and will build and deliver AI products using an agentic, AI-native approach, where AI agents are designed into products and workflows from the start rather than added later. The role scales safe and measurable AI adoption across engineering and business teams, and partners with McKesson's Enterprise AI team so capabilities are built once and reused across business units. This is a builder's role for someone who combines technical depth, product delivery, strategic vision, and the ability to change how people work.


Key Responsibilities:


AI Strategy and Roadmap

  • Define and own the AI enablement strategy and multi-year roadmap for CoverMyMeds, aligned with business priorities and McKesson's enterprise AI direction.
  • Manage a portfolio of concurrent AI initiatives and a multimillion-dollar budget, prioritizing investments by business value, risk, and reuse.
  • Measure and report AI adoption, productivity, and ROI to executive leadership.

Agentic-Native Product Build and Delivery

  • Own the build and delivery of AI products and agents end to end, from discovery and design through production release and ongoing improvement.
  • Champion an agentic-native approach: design products and workflows around AI agents from the start, with humans in the loop where it matters.
  • Partner with Product and business leaders to identify high-value use cases and turn them into products that deliver measurable clinical, operational, and financial outcomes.
  • Use AI-accelerated delivery to move from idea to production in days and weeks, while holding the bar on quality, security, and compliance.

Governance and Responsible AI

  • Chair the AI Review Board and own AI usage policy, model-selection frameworks, and token allocation and cost management.
  • Ensure HIPAA, privacy, and security requirements are built into AI development and delivery processes.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Compliance to enable fast, safe, and responsible AI adoption.

AI Platforms and Engineering Acceleration

  • Lead the teams that build and run reusable AI capabilities, including the AI Skills Marketplace, MCP servers, agents, and developer tooling.
  • Advance the AI-embedded SDLC, including spec-driven development, AI code review, automated vulnerability remediation, shift-left testing, and self-service developer onboarding.
  • Drive build-once, reuse-everywhere practices so shared AI assets serve multiple teams and business units.

Adoption, Enablement, and Change

  • Scale AI adoption beyond engineering to product, business, legal, finance, privacy, call center, and platform teams.
  • Own the AI training curriculum and champions network, from foundational AI literacy to advanced agentic workflows.
  • Advise senior leadership and the C-suite on AI strategy, capabilities, and risk.
  • Build a positive, curious AI culture through townhalls, ERG sessions, and hands-on enablement.

Partnership and Leadership

  • Partner with McKesson's Enterprise AI team, architecture, product, and platform leaders to align standards and avoid duplicate effort.
  • Work with external technology partners and vendors to evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities.
  • Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of engineers, architects, and enablement specialists.

Basic Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Typically requires 13+ years of relative software engineering and technology leadership experience, including 5+ years leading engineering or platform teams.
  • 3+ years of hands-on leadership in AI or ML, including generative AI, LLMs, and agentic AI in production environments.
  • Proven track record of driving AI adoption at scale with measurable outcomes in productivity, quality, or delivery speed.
  • Demonstrated experience building and delivering AI-powered products or agents to production, with measurable business impact.
  • Experience establishing AI governance, responsible AI practices, or technology standards in a regulated environment.
  • Experience managing people, budgets, vendor relationships, and a portfolio of concurrent initiatives.

Preferred Experience:

  • Master's degree in a technical field or an MBA.
  • Healthcare, pharmacy, or health technology experience, including HIPAA and patient data protection.
  • Experience with AI developer tooling such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience with FHIR and healthcare interoperability standards.
  • Experience in a matrixed, multi-business-unit enterprise.

Technical Skills:

  • Generative and agentic AI: LLMs, RAG, agents, prompt and context engineering, model evaluation.
  • Agentic-native product design: multi-agent workflows, tool use, human-in-the-loop design, and agent observability and evaluation.
  • Product delivery: discovery, MVP definition, rapid iteration, and production release.
  • AI platform engineering: MCP, reusable skills and plugins, AI marketplaces, LLMOps.
  • Modern SDLC: spec-driven development, CI/CD, DevOps, Cyber Security, automated testing and code review.
  • Cloud-native architecture (GCP or AWS), APIs, and integration platforms.
  • Data foundations for AI, including data quality, tagging, and synthetic data.

Leadership:

  • Strategic vision and the ability to turn it into an executable roadmap.
  • Executive communication and influence, including explaining complex technical topics simply.
  • Change leadership: moving teams from skepticism to confident, everyday AI use.
  • Cross-functional partnership with Legal, Privacy, Security, Product, and business leaders.
  • Talent development and building inclusive, high-performing teams.
  • Data-driven decisions, with a focus on measurable outcomes and ROI.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year:

  • AI adoption continues to grow across engineering and expands further into business functions.
  • New agentic-native AI products are delivered to production with measurable business outcomes.
  • Governance keeps pace with new AI capabilities without slowing delivery.
  • Reusable AI assets are adopted across multiple teams and business units, reducing duplicate effort.
  • Clear, regular reporting on AI adoption, productivity, and ROI to executive leadership.

Join Us as a Principal Clinical Trial Coordinator FSP– Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation! We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotech’s, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

Summary of Essential Functions:

  • Attends kick-off meetings and supports training to team members, investigators, or clients as needed.
  • Serves as study eTMF lead, handling client integration and (e)TMF activities.
  • Provides technical and administrative support for project coordination to meet study-level milestone targets.

  • Support with preparations for Investigator Meetings
  • Maintaining and coordinating the logistical aspects of clinical projects and provide overall support to functional leads to ensure the successful completion of project deliverables.
  • Initiates the preparation of all project/program plans required by client contracts by reviewing contract and communicating with functional area leads.
  • Coordinates project/program/protocol specific and therapeutic area training needs. Tracks and follows up on all training, non-disclosure agreements, and security clearance requests.
  • Performs basic project financial management tasks as assigned.
  • Acts as task order/work assignment lead on small scopes of work for contracts/projects of low complexity.
  • Escalates compliance to established project-specific parameters and client expectations.
  • As Project Specialists ensures the contracted services and expectations of assigned projects are carried out by the project teams in accordance with executed contracts and the customers’ requirements.
  • Maintaining timely and effective communication among team members, site staff and providing support for quality assurance activities, including preparation for audits and internal review, preparing documentation and follow through to resolution.
  • Maintenance and tracking of SOPs, client directives, and regulatory guidelines at the project level.
  • Contributes to discussions with teammates to support collaboration and best practices.
  • Expands therapeutic knowledge and expertise.

In addition to tasks listed above essential functions will include tasks below with increased skill level and years of experience above Principal CTC.

  • Develops site list and ensures contact details are maintained in Client/PPD systems including Veeva.
  • Provides admin and technical support to study management and program teams, including:
    • Supports meeting scheduling, minute taking, document creation and transmission.
    • May maintain vendor trackers.
    • Works with sites to obtain relevant documents.
    • Completes site interest plan and documents site communications.
    • Works directly with sites to obtain site qualification, selection and start-up documents.
    • Works with CSO to develop the site list and ensures contact details are maintained in Client/PPD systems including Veeva.
  • Performs document processing and follow-up tasks, including:
    • Initial quality checks of eTMF documents, file reviews, and documents findings.
    • Request eTraining report reviews to begin on a quarterly basis
    • Performs file reviews and documents findings in appropriate system, including tracking local regulatory documents.
    • Supports maintenance of study-specific documentation and global systems/tools.
    • May conduct quarterly eTMF completeness checks.
  • Coordinates and completes assigned activities ensuring proactive scheduling and fulfillment, aligned with project team needs, including:
    • Provides system access (e.g., Veeva & eTMF) and inputting site and study information into current databases and generating reports.
    • Analyzes and reconcile study metrics and findings reports, clarifying and resolving issues related to site documentation.
    • Assists with coordination, compilation, and distribution of Investigator Site File (ISF) and supplies to sites.
    • May maintain vendor trackers.
    • Ensures efficient site contact and follow-up plan, escalating concerns as needed.
  • Assists with Study Start-up and ongoing submission activities as needed
    • Transmits documents to centralized IRB/IEC (on-going).
    • Request insurance in each country
    • Coordinates with key QSDO functions to align site start-up activities.
    • May support study-specific translation of materials and QC.
    • May be requested to help with checking if CDAs exist/are expired & obtaining a new Inv/Institution CDA.
    • May work with the CTT Representative, to provide relevant study information
  • Other essential tasks and principal duties:
    • Supports survey data review and collaboration with teammates.
    • May liaise and contributes to feasibility processes.
    • Compliant with general and study specific training, ensuring knowledge of relevant SOPs and regulatory guidance.
    • Contributes to the development of best practices.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree preferred.

• Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years).

In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.
